Title: Assistant Manager - Pouching
Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Assistant Manager – Pouching Department

**Department:**Production – Pouching  
**Reports To:**Production Manager / Plant Head

1. Job PurposeTo manage and control all pouching operations to achieve production targets, optimum machine utilization, required quality standards, on-time delivery, minimum wastage, and efficient manpower utilization while ensuring compliance with safety and company procedures.2. Key Responsibilities**A. Production Planning and Execution**

* Execute daily and monthly production plans as per customer requirements and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimum utilization of pouching machines, manpower, and available resources.
* Monitor production output, machine speeds, efficiency, downtime, and order completion.
* Ensure timely changeovers, job preparation, and smooth production flow.
* Coordinate with Planning, Printing, Lamination, Slitting, QA, Maintenance, departments.
* Take corrective action to recover production losses and meet daily targets.

**B. Productivity and Cost Control**

* Achieve defined targets for output, productivity, machine utilization, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), where applicable.
* Minimize material wastage, start-up rejection, sealing defects, and pouching losses.
* Monitor production performance against established standards and identify improvement opportunities.
* Improve machine running speeds and reduce setup, changeover, and idle time.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to increase capacity and reduce conversion costs.

**C. Quality Management**

* Ensure production conforms to approved specifications, customer requirements, and quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters such as sealing temperature, pressure, dwell time, registration, dimensions, zipper alignment, gusset formation, and cutting accuracy, as applicable to the pouch type.
* Ensure first-piece approval and regular in-process quality checks.
* Prevent defects such as seal leakage, wrinkles, misregistration, poor cutting, contamination, and dimensional variation.
* Ensure traceability, correct material identification, and proper recording of production and quality data.
* Coordinate with QA to investigate non-conformities, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure rejected and non-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, and controlled.

**D. Manpower Management**

* Allocate operators and helpers according to machine loading and production priorities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity, and operator performance.
* Develop operator skills through training, coaching, and competency assessments.
* Ensure proper shift handover and effective communication between shifts.
* Build a multi-skilled workforce to improve operational flexibility.

**E. Machine Maintenance and Performance**

* Coordinate with Maintenance to ensure preventive maintenance and timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor recurring breakdowns and implement measures to reduce downtime.
* Ensure machines, tools, sealing jaws, cutting systems, and other accessories are maintained in good working condition.
* Ensure proper machine settings, changeover practices, and equipment handling.
* Report technical issues and recommend improvements to enhance machine reliability.

**F. Safety, Housekeeping and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company safety rules, machine guarding, and lockout/tagout procedures where applicable.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping, and cleanliness throughout the department.
* Ensure safe handling of materials, tools, and equipment.
* Promote a safety-first culture and report incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality, food-contact packaging, hygiene, and customer requirements.

**G. Reporting and Documentation**

* Prepare daily production and shift performance reports.
* Monitor output, efficiency, downtime, wastage, rejection, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure accurate recording of production data in ERP systems.
* Analyze performance gaps and submit action plans to the Production Manager.
* Maintain records of machine settings, quality checks, changeovers, downtime, and material reconciliation.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated against approved departmental targets for:

* Production output versus plan.
* Machine efficiency and utilization.
* Downtime and breakdown losses.
* Material wastage and rejection percentage.
* Quality defects and customer complaints.
* On-time order completion.
* Setup and changeover time.
* Manpower productivity and overtime control.
* Preventive maintenance compliance.
* Safety, housekeeping, and audit compliance.
* ERP data accuracy and timely reporting.
* Continuous improvement and cost reduction.

4. Qualifications and Experience

* Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* 12-15 years of experience in pouching department experience; out of which 3 to 4 yrs as pouching in charge or AM pouching
* Experience in operating and managing pouching machines for different pouch formats, such as three-side seal, centre seal, stand-up pouch, zipper pouch, flat bottom 3 D pouch , quad pouch and other applicable formats.
* Knowledge of flexible packaging materials, laminates, sealing characteristics, pouch specifications, and defect analysis.
* Experience in production planning, manpower management, troubleshooting, quality control, and productivity improvement.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, production reporting, Excel, and root-cause analysis.

5. Required Competencies

* Strong production planning and execution skills.
* Leadership and manpower management.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Knowledge of pouching technology, process parameters and various pouching machine tools for all purposes.
* Focus on quality, productivity, waste reduction, and cost control.
* Effective coordination with cross-functional departments.
* Accountability, discipline, and continuous improvement mindset.

6. Authority and Accountability

* Allocate manpower and machines according to the approved production plan.
* Adjust machine settings within approved process specifications.
* Stop production when critical quality or safety issues are identified.
* Escalate material shortages, major breakdowns, quality deviations, and delivery risks.
* Recommend process improvements, training, and maintenance interventions.
* Accountable for departmental production performance, product quality, wastage, safety, and manpower utilization.

**Overall Accountability: To** ensure safe, efficient, cost-effective, and quality-compliant pouching operations while consistently achieving production and delivery targets.

Pay: AED7,500.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Title: Senior Director Information Technology
Description:
**Vacancy Status**
: Full Time, 15 Month Contract

**Position Description:**

The Toronto Region Board of Trade is seeking a Senior Director, Information Technology for a 15-month contract to lead the Board's IT team. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, you will ensure the Board's systems remain secure, reliable and well-supported, and serve as a trusted technology partner across all levels of the organization. This role oversees IT operations, business applications, vendor partnerships, cybersecurity and in-flight technology initiatives within a Microsoft-centred environment that includes Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. In addition to progressive IT leadership experience, the ideal candidate will be a clear communicator, highly collaborative, and able to step into an established environment quickly, combining sound strategic judgment with a hands-on approach to day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:

***Technology Leadership & Execution***

* Serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Financial Officer and leadership team, providing clear, concise updates and recommendations.
* Ensures technology priorities remain aligned with organizational goals and carries forward in-flight initiatives to agreed milestones.
* Maintains a strong understanding of the organization’s technology environment and remains actively involved in the execution and resolution of day-to-day technology matters.
* Identifies opportunities to improve technology effectiveness, reliability and user experience, with a focus on practical solutions appropriate for a 50-100-person organization.

***AI Implementation & Adoption***

* Supports the implementation of agentic AI solutions across the organization, working with business teams and external partners to identify practical use cases, configure and test solutions, and integrate them into everyday workflows.
* Manages and supports the Board’s AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, overseeing licensing, access, configuration and technical support.
* Coordinates the technical requirements for AI implementation, including system integrations, data access, testing and deployment, ensuring appropriate security controls and human oversight in accordance with the Board’s AI use policy.
* Provides practical guidance, training and troubleshooting to help employees adopt AI tools and apply them effectively in their work.

***Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Leads, supports and develops the IT team, setting priorities and managing performance and KPIs.
* Provides service to all areas of the Board by applying business partner skills and a client service outlook.
* Allocates work effectively across the team and ensures appropriate coverage for operational priorities, projects and employee support.
* Documents key decisions and changes to support a smooth transition at the end of the contract.

***Vendor Management, Security & Compliance***

* Manages the relationships with key technology partners, including the managed services providers; monitors performance and oversees renewals and negotiations.
* Leads vendor escalations and ensures unresolved service issues are addressed quickly and effectively.
* Maintains the Board's cybersecurity posture across Azure and Microsoft 365, including identity, access and data protection.
* Upholds IT policies, including the Board's AI use policy, and supports compliance with accessibility (AODA) and privacy requirements.

***IT Operations & Service Delivery***

* Oversees the reliable day-to-day operation of IT infrastructure and technology services at both the Board’s event space at 100 Queens Quay and corporate office at 21 Melinda, including network connectivity, Wi-Fi, end-user services, collaboration tools and telephony.
* Takes a hands-on role in addressing operational issues, troubleshooting escalated concerns and coordinating resolution with internal team members and external vendors.
* Manages the IT operating calendar, including renewals, reviews and as needed event support.
* Maintains service levels and resolves escalated issues promptly.
* Oversees technology onboarding and offboarding, hardware and software provisioning, access management and equipment lifecycle requirements.

***Business Applications & Data***

* Oversees the Board's infrastructure including: CRM, marketing automation, finance, event management system, payments, website and related platforms.
* Works directly with business teams and vendors to troubleshoot issues, manage enhancements and ensure systems are configured to support operational requirements.
* Coordinates system upgrades, integrations, implementations and changes, ensuring appropriate testing, communication, documentation and employee support.
* Supports reporting and analytics through Power BI and champions low-code solutions on the Power Platform where they add value.
* Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes, simplify workflows and improve productivity using existing technology.

**Your experience includes:**

* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading IT teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong working knowledge of a Microsoft-centred environment, including Azure, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365.
* Practical experience implementing or supporting AI tools and workflow automation, including technical deployment and employee adoption; experience with agentic AI solutions considered an asset.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure, connectivity, audiovisual systems and technology support across multiple locations, including corporate office and event environments.
* Proven experience managing managed service providers and external agencies, including contracts and performance.
* Solid grounding in cybersecurity practices for a cloud-first organization.
* Experience managing an IT budget and reporting to senior executives.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; experience explaining technical matters to partners at all levels.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and collaboratively with business units.
* Experience with Business Central, Power BI, ClickDimensions, CMS considered an asset.

**You’re often described as:**

* A steady, pragmatic leader who builds trust quickly with a new team
* A business partner first, able to translate organizational needs into practical technology solutions
* Highly organized and able to navigate competing priorities and deadlines
* A self-starter who can work independently from a structured handover
* A strong communicator, collaborative with colleagues from all levels and departments
* Security-minded, detail-oriented and accountable

**Working Conditions:**

* Full-time position, hybrid with 3-4 days in office.
* May require occasional evening and weekend work for system maintenance or emergencies.
* On-call availability for critical system issues.

**Compensation & Benefits**

TRBOT is committed to fair, equitable pay that matches the responsibility and expertise behind every role.

This role has an annual salary range of $120,000-$170,000.

At TRBOT, performance plays an important role in pay progression. As you build your skills, take on new challenges, and make an impact, your compensation will evolve to reflect that progress. Regular development check-ins with your manager keep your path clear and your momentum strong.

We encourage open dialogue about compensation at every stage of the interview proto ensure transparency and trust. Ask us anything—we want you to feel informed and confident from day one.

At Toronto Region Board of Trade, you work closely with a collaborative, results-driven team of city builders. You will be centre stage on the issues that matter to the region. Working at Toronto Region Board of Trade gives you an opportunity to work with thought leaders, while collaborating with our dynamic, diverse membership.

* Accountability – We are accountable to our Members, stakeholders and each other.

* Connections – We engage and build communities.

Title: Technical Program Manager II (6396)
Description:
**Technical Program Manager II**

itD is seeking an Incident Communications & Program Manager to support advertising platform reliability for a leading global technology organization. This role will own day-to-day incident communications, including deciding when a communication is needed, drafting it, taking it through Legal approval, and publishing it. It will also run readiness for major advertiser sales events and build AI-driven workflow automations. The ideal candidate will bring strong writing under time pressure, experience in technical, incident, or crisis communications or program coordination, hands-on use of generative AI tools, and the judgment to run recurring operational work independently, including a higher level of on-call responsibility. This is a 12-month contract with potential for extension.

**Location:** Remote - US (candidates must work in Pacific, Central, or Mountain time)

**Duration:** 12 months

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more. Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve on the incident communications on-call rotation and work with incident managers to decide whether an incident needs communications, using defined criteria (severity, revenue impact, number of affected advertisers, duration).
* Draft advertiser-facing, sales-facing, and leadership communications for incidents of all severity levels, translating technical root causes into plain, accurate language.
* Run the approval process with Legal, advertiser communications, incident managers, and policy partners, then publish approved messages to the right sales and leadership channels within target timelines.
* Track follow-ups after mitigation, including refund timelines and revenue impact, and send recap communications to leadership.
* Keep the communications playbook and library of pre-approved, plug-and-play templates current, and draft new templates and take them through Legal and Sales approval.
* Escalate to the program TPM only for exceptions such as unclear criteria, disputed approvals, or high-visibility incidents.
* Run day-to-day readiness for major advertiser sales events (such as Black Friday) and major customer product launches, including kickoff, preparation checklists, task owners, and deadlines.
* Coordinate engineering, sales, support, and partner teams before, during, and after each event, and escalate open incidents that threaten an event to their owners.
* Run event command-center communications, status updates, and post-event summaries.
* Execute other short-duration programs as assigned by the program TPM (for example tooling migrations, holiday on-call scheduling, and cross-team outreach campaigns) with clear plans, trackers, and status reporting.
* Keep processes, playbooks, checklists, and trackers current as the program evolves, and propose improvements to the program TPM.
* Use AI assistants daily to draft communications, summarize incidents and meetings, and prepare status updates.
* Build, test, and maintain AI-driven automations, such as an incident alert that creates a task, checks for a related incident, and drafts a communication for human approval.
* Monitor automated workflows, catch and fix failures, and keep humans in the loop on approvals.

**Internal Responsibilities:**

* Attend regular internal practice community meetings.
* Collaborate with your itD practice team on industry thought leadership.
* Complete client case studies and learning material (blogs, media material).
* Build out material to contribute to the Digital Transformation practice.
* Attend internal itD networking events (in person and virtual).
* Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

**Required Qualifications and Skills:**

* 4+ years in technical communications, incident or crisis communications, or program coordination at a technology company.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, accurate messages for advertisers, sales teams, and executives under time pressure.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in daily work and building automated workflows with AI or low-code tools.
* Proven ability to run recurring operational work independently with little supervision and to know when to escalate.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional programs or events with many stakeholders and tight deadlines.
* Comfort working with Legal and communications approval processes.
* Organized and reliable on an on-call rotation, including during live incidents and peak-season workload.
* Discretion in handling confidential incident and advertiser information, following Legal-approved communication processes and data confidentiality policies.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills:**

* Experience in digital advertising or ad tech, especially advertiser-facing operations.
* Familiarity with incident management concepts (severity levels, mitigation, post-incident review).
* Experience supporting peak retail or sales events.
* Experience with task trackers, dashboards, and Slack-based workflows.

**Education:**  
Bachelor's degree required.

**Company Description**  
About itD: We are part of a new generation of consulting and software development company that blends diversity, innovation, and integrity with real business results. Our structure rejects any strong hierarchy, empowering us to deliver excellent results. We are a woman- and minority-led firm. Every day, we challenge ourselves to be considerate, fair and to re-think what great outcomes mean for our customers. This permeates down to how we approach every interaction, on every project, for every client. You'll thrive here if you are a dynamic self-starter, a difference-maker or someone who wants to deliver great results, without constraints.

The itD Digital Experience: Joining us means you'll be part of our global community, you have a say about your own career journey, and you'll get a chance to give back to causes that matter. You will experience working with Fortune 500 companies and high-performance teams across numerous industries. itD offers our employees excellent benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid holidays, 401K + matching, networking & career learning and development programs. We are growing and we want to see you grow! Visit https://itdtech.com/careers to learn more about what working at itD can mean for you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law. itD is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Title: Regional Central Intake Director
Description:
**Regional Central Intake Director**

**Part-time Position | Fully Remote**

**Saturday-Sunday/Weekends Only**

**Must live in the PST time zone**

**$26-$35 per hour DOE**

Turn your job into a career with Evergreen Healthcare Group!

**Job Summary**

The **Regional Central Intake Director** is responsible for overseeing and managing the daily intake process for skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) across designated regions. This role ensures timely response to all incoming referrals, coordinates communication between clinical teams and facility leadership, and manages the referral entry process utilizing the Green/Yellow/Red guidelines. The ideal candidate will have in-depth knowledge of the SNF admission process, strong communication skills, and the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. This position interfaces closely with the admission team in the facility as well as the Regional Director of Business Development. The Regional Central Intake Director will represent all facilities and must maintain a stellar level of professionalism, customer service and empathy in all patient communications.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Follow the Green/Yellow/Red guidelines for responding to all referrals through electronic portals (EPIC, AIDA, WellSky, Careport, e-fax) within a goal of 30 minutes or less.
* Perform medication cost-outs for necessary referrals to ensure accurate financial assessment.
* Communicate "yellow" referrals to the facility's clinical team, including the District Director of Clinical, Regional Director of Clinical, Area Director of Admissions, and facility Administrator for further evaluation.
* Enter all referrals into the PCC CRM system accurately for designated facilities.
* Collaborate closely with the facility clinical team to ensure smooth transitions from referral to admission.
* Communicate effectively and promptly with hospital personnel regarding acceptances and denials
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of SNF admission regulations and industry best practices

  **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**
* Strong knowledge of the SNF admission process and referral management.
* Must understand medical terminology and clinical capability grids (Green/Yellow/Red)
* Approachable, flexible and adaptable to change
* Organized and detail oriented
* Effective verbal and written English communication skills
* Familiar with various insurances, including, but not limited to: Medicare, Medicaid, Managed Care
* Ability to work with minimal supervision, take initiative and make independent decisions
* Comfortable reviewing and responding to SNF referrals through various electronic portals and e-fax.
* Proficient with computer systems, including Microsoft Word, Outlook, and PCC.
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate effectively across clinical and administrative teams.
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing tasks based on urgency.
* Self-starter with excellent time management and problem-solving skill

**EDUCATION, LICENSURE, AND EXPERIENCE**

* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in admissions, marketing, or a related field within the Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) industry.
* Clinical licensure preferred but not required

**REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS**

* Reports to Director of Admission Integration

**Working Environment:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

* 100% Remote
* General office environment. Position involves sitting, standing, lifting, bending, walking and moving frequently during workday.

We strive to embody and stand for both a spirit and value system that encourages loyalty, honesty, and a commitment to caring from our belief that people are always the number one priority.

Description:
The Executive Director, Utilities leads the City Operations utilities mandate across Qiddiya City, covering power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, ICT, water bodies, lagoons and other utility systems within scope. The role is accountable for improving the operational management and resilience of existing interim networks, water bodies and lagoons; protecting continuity of service during construction; defining the city-wide utilities strategy, ownership model and operating standards; and ensuring permanent utility and water assets are planned, designed, delivered and accepted in line with City Operations and Qiddiya City Authority requirements. Reporting to the City Chief Operations Officer, the role coordinates closely with planning, design, delivery, district and asset teams, QTech, Smart City, utility providers, regulators and O&M partners to manage material service, capacity, water-quality, commercial and reputational risks.
  
  
**Utilities Strategy and Asset Ownership**

* Develop and implement the City Operations strategy for all utilities, water bodies and lagoons, including service outcomes, water quality, resilience, governance, ownership, operating and cost model, standards and long-term investment priorities.
* Determine which interim and permanent utility assets will be adopted by City Operations and which will be owned or operated by utilities, districts, assets or other third parties, with clear decision rights and accountability.
* Improve the operational management, asset information, condition oversight and service performance of existing interim power, potable water, renewed water and ICT networks.
* Develop and implement a protection and continuity strategy for live interim utility networks during construction, recognising that outages create a material operational and reputational risk for Qiddiya.
* Maintain an accurate city-wide utilities asset register and GIS record, including surveys of existing interim networks and requirements for any relocation arising from development works.
* Advise the City Chief Operations Officer and governance on utility priorities, delivery dependencies, capacity constraints, temporary solutions, investment needs and material operational risks.

**Planning, Design and Operational Assurance**

* Coordinate with planning, design and delivery teams to accelerate permanent utility assets needed for growing city-wide operational, development and major-event requirements.
* Define City Operations requirements and assure their incorporation into utility strategies, project briefs, designs, specifications, delivery plans and permanent-asset operating models.
* Verify that interim and full-build infrastructure can meet peak utility loads, including concurrent major-event scenarios and increased city footfall, with adequate redundancy and recovery arrangements.
* Lead operational assurance of critical dependencies and interfaces, including permanent and temporary power, potable and renewed water capacity, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, utility corridors, ICT connectivity and data-centre requirements.
* Coordinate space planning for utility operational centres, O&M yards, workshops and equipment and spare-parts storage, confirming the required number, location and functionality across Qiddiya City.
* Participate in multidisciplinary stage-gate reviews and challenge solutions to optimise safety, service continuity, maintainability, whole-life cost, efficiency and operational readiness.

**Readiness, Handover and Asset Acceptance**

* Establish utility readiness, testing, commissioning, handover and operational acceptance requirements, including permits, asset data, GIS records, operating procedures, warranties, spares, training and defect closure.
* Assess acceptance evidence and recommend City Operations acceptance only where ownership, operating responsibility, funding and service interfaces are clear.
* Aggregate city-wide O&M requirements and lead the technical and operational strategy for a multi-year city-wide utilities O&M services procurement, coordinating with Commercial, Procurement, Finance and Legal.
* Coordinate mobilisation and transition arrangements for interim and permanent networks, including temporary service extensions where delays to permanent assets require continued use of temporary power, water or ICT solutions.
* Ensure adopted assets are captured in the asset management system and GIS with complete, accurate and usable information for safe operation and maintenance.

**Performance, Risk and Lifecycle Management**

* Establish KPIs and executive reporting for availability, outages, reliability, water quality, water-body and lagoon condition, capacity, losses, consumption, compliance, incidents, cost, complaints and recovery performance.
* Maintain a consolidated utilities risk and dependency register covering delivery slippage, temporary-network fragility, corridor and land constraints, capacity shortfalls, construction interfaces and unbudgeted temporary solutions.
* Develop lifecycle, renewal and investment plans based on criticality, condition, service demand, resilience, regulatory requirements and whole-life value.
* Confirm the operational data required for smart utilities, align the Siemens utilities integration study with QTech and Smart City initiatives, and define requirements for monitoring, analytics and future digital-twin capability.
* Ensure emergency, outage, business continuity and recovery plans are coordinated with City Operations, districts, assets, utility providers, safety, security and event functions.

**Commercial, Regulatory and Stakeholder Management**

* Define the utilities cost-recovery model, including cost allocation, metering, tariffs or charges, billing inputs, subsidy requirements, subsidy period and governance for costs levied on operational assets.
* Lead the utility component of the city service charge in collaboration with the Executive Director, City Asset Management and Finance and Control, ensuring transparent and auditable recovery mechanisms.
* Draft and implement service level agreements between City Operations and districts or assets for utilities adopted by City Operations, including service standards, responsibilities, escalation, outage communication and performance reporting.
* Develop City Operations codes, standards and guidelines for construction in the vicinity of live utility assets, including permits, protection measures, access controls and incident response.
* Manage strategic interfaces with authorities, regulators, Saudi Electricity, water entities, telecoms providers, developers, districts, operators and specialist O&M service providers.
* Ensure statutory, technical, environmental, commercial and contractual obligations are identified, governed and evidenced across all adopted utilities.

**Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a capable municipal utilities team with clear accountability, effective governance and disciplined delivery.
* Develop Saudi talent through structured recruitment, mentoring, role exposure, succession planning and knowledge transfer from advisers, delivery partners and operators.
* Promote collaboration, technical rigour, commercial discipline, innovation and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**
**Education and Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, utilities, infrastructure, asset management or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in engineering, asset management, business or a related field is advantageous.
* Relevant professional registration or accreditation in engineering, utilities, asset management or project management is preferred.

**Experience**

* Substantial executive leadership experience in city-wide utilities, infrastructure asset management or utility network development within a complex city, municipality, mixed-use destination or major development programme.
* Demonstrated experience managing live interim or temporary utility networks while permanent infrastructure is planned and delivered in an active construction environment.
* Strong experience across utility strategy, planning, design assurance, construction interfaces, testing, commissioning, handover, operational acceptance and service mobilisation.
* Proven experience in network resilience, outage management, peak-demand planning, lifecycle investment, GIS and asset information, operational data and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated experience developing utility O&M procurement strategies, SLAs, performance regimes, tariffs, metering, billing, cost-recovery or subsidy models.
* Proven ability to manage interfaces among developers, delivery teams, authorities, regulators, utilities, districts, operators and service providers; experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC is strongly preferred.

**Technical and Functional Expectations**

* Expert understanding of city-wide utility asset management, live-network operations and governance of networked infrastructure.
* Strong working knowledge of power, potable water, renewed water, wastewater, stormwater, water bodies and lagoons, ICT and associated corridors, facilities and operational dependencies.
* Ability to assess demand, capacity, reliability, redundancy, pressure and flow constraints, metering, efficiency, service continuity, emergency recovery and whole-life cost.
* Strong understanding of GIS, asset registers, operational technology, smart-utility data, analytics and digital-twin opportunities.
* Clear understanding of asset-owner, developer, regulator, network operator, O&M manager, district, asset and service-provider accountability boundaries.
* Strong commercial judgement, procurement capability, risk management, data-led decision-making and executive reporting.

Title: Armed Assistant Security Account Manager
Description:

------------

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Hiring for a Security Armed Assistant Account Manager

Join the world’s leading global security company!

* Salary :$87,550.06/ Year
* Location: Downtown Los Angeles, California
* Excellent benefits and career growth opportunities

Allied Universal is looking to hire an Assistant Account Manager. The Assistant Account Manager job is responsible for assisting the Account Manager with all supervisory, training and operations functions at the assigned post in accordance with post orders and client instructions, and following all internal procedures. To support and ensure success in this role, we provide a comprehensive, week-long management onboarding course designed to provide best practices, tools and guidance.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Under the direction of the Account Manager, this position assists with the coordination of all aspects (technical and managerial) of executing the security contract at the assigned location. Assigns work tasks to Security Professionals and directs their work throughout the day
* This position is the first direct supervisory contact for shift supervisors (if applicable to site) or for Security Professionals, regarding performance, operations, and department needs. Responsible for supervising, motivating, coaching and training Also responsible for evaluating the work performance of Security Professionals and making recommendations regarding assignments
* Responsible for making sure that Post Order manual and all other post and training information is being properly maintained and updated, and that the Post is being properly maintained, cleaned and organized
* Assist the Account Manager in conducting interviews and evaluating new employees. Responsible for conducting on-the-job training, in coordination with Shift Supervisors, of new employees assigned to post, or when changes to post orders are made. This may include orientation to the post, review of post orders, routine responsibilities, and how to respond to emergency situations or specific client needs;
* Oversees all reports, logs and pass downs generated by and for the Security Department. Distributes communications and other information to Security Professionals at post as directed
* Manages and supervises all sub-units within the Security Department, such as fire control room, command center, and loading docks as applicable to job site. May generate work orders and attached paperwork for extra security coverage requests
* Responds to minor incidents (internal to Security Professionals and/or external to client location) that occur, ensuring appropriate action is taken, all reports are properly completed, and appropriate parties are notified in a timely manner
* Identifies any personnel problems occurring at posts, such as payroll issues, employee relations complaints or other concerns, and forward any such issues to Account Manager or Field Supervisor as appropriate. May be responsible for writing a report of the situation or assisting with an investigation, as directed by Account Manager, Branch Manager or Corporate HR Director
* Responsible for making recommendations for counseling and/or disciplinary action, including termination. May be responsible for administering counseling or disciplinary actions (may not make or initiate such decisions on his/her own, but may execute such actions at the specific direction of Account Manager with prior approval from Branch/Corporate HR management)
* Responds to client or site emergencies as they arise, including ensuring appropriate communication to Account Manager, Field Supervisor, Branch and/or Regional Manager. Responsible for maintaining positive client/security relationships through frequent tenant/client contact and support
* May occasionally perform Security Professional type job duties on an as-needed basis by standing post, but under no circumstances to exceed more than 50% of time in any given workweek.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum high school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum three (3) – five (5) years of professional-level experience required. Prior experience in the security industry, law enforcement and/or military required
* Must possess a valid state Guard License, or have applied and subsequently be issued such a license prior to employment. As a condition of employment, employee must successfully complete a background investigation and a post-offer/pre-employment drug/alcohol test. Additionally, as a condition of continued employment, employee must maintain current active status of Guard License at all times, and must carry the license at all times while on duty
* Driving Positions: must possess a valid Driver’s License with at least one year of driving experience, a clean driving record (no major violations within last 36 months, no more than 1 accident in last 24 months, no more than one minor moving violation in last 24 months), a minimum level of insurance as required by Company policy, and the ability to safely operate a vehicle required.
* Energetic and focused personality with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, successfully handle and prioritize multiple competing assignments and effectively manage deadlines. Demonstration of strong customer service orientation required, with ability to effectively resolve client issues in a professional and service-focused manner and to de-escalate situations before they become hostile or unpleasant required
* Professional, articulate and able to use good independent judgment and discretion
* Ability to train and coach others, and to effectively enforce post orders, security standards and company policies equitably and consistently
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills required. Ability to successfully interact at all levels of the organization, including with clients, while functioning as a team player required
* Incumbent must be available to work outside normal shift schedule on an as-needed basis, and must be accessible by phone or pager 24/7 for emergency response

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* College education or business classes
* Experience in scheduling, operations or other functions of security industry
* Ability to write effective and concise reports in neat, legible handwriting is required. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software and email

**BENEFITS:**

* Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, retirement plan, and disability insurance
* Eight paid holidays annually, five sick days, and four personal days
* Vacation time offered at an accrual rate of 3.08 hours biweekly; unused vacation is only paid out where required by law

Title: Assistant Director of Nursing (RN/LPN)
Description:
**Attn: RNs/LPNs**

**DEPARTMENT:** Nursing

**SUPERVISOR:** Director of Nursing

**POSITION SUMMARY:** The purpose of the Assists the Director of Nursing (ADON) position is provide support and oversight to the nursing department by organizing and managing nursing services provided by the facility.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** The following represents the essential functions of the Assistant Director of Nursing's role. This list is intended to be a general description of duties and responsibilities; however, it is subject to change according to the needs of the facility determined by the Administrator and/or corporate designee.

  

* Assists the DON in the supervision of nursing care and nursing staff.
* The ADON participates in Daily QA (morning) Meetings, Monthly/ Quarterly QA, Safety Committee Meetings, High Risk Meetings, Resident Council Meetings when requested, Care Plan Meetings, in-service trainings, continuing education programs, and all other meetings called by Legacy or licensing entities.
* The ADON assists in management, delegation, and contribution to nursing department programs such as weights, infection control, incidents and accidents, gradual dose reductions, etc.
* Assists in carrying out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with organizational policies and scope of practice.
* Supervisory responsibilities include:
* Interviews, recommends, hires, and trains employees.
* Plans, assigns, and directs work.
* Prepares schedule, taking into consideration resident needs and safety, experience, knowledge, and ability of the persons to whom the assignments are made.
* Receives calls and finds helps replacements for absent staff. Notifies the DON and/or Administrator of staffing concerns and prepares a plan to resolve them.
* Transfers employees among units as needed.
* Prepares performance evaluations with the understanding that such evaluations impact tenure of probationary employees and wage increases of non-probationary employees.
* Meaningfully rewards and disciplines employees with the understanding that such discipline results in termination of employment through progressive steps.
* Schedules lunch and break times to meet the needs of the residents and staff.
* Approves the correction of errors in timecards or other timekeeping records.
* Authorizes overtime with DON and/ or Administrator discretion.
* Receives and helps resolve residents and employee complaints.
* Determines rotation of employees within facility.
* Monitors and corrects job performance of employees.
* Oversees facility in absence of higher-ranking management officials. If an RN, functions as acting DON in the absence of the DON.
* Uses independent judgment and discretion on behalf of the organization in the performance of these duties.
* Helps the DON with the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the nursing department.
* Helps to verify the current licensure and credentials of nursing employees.
* Performs resident rounds to monitor and evaluate the quality and appropriateness of nursing care.
* Assists in monitoring, charting, and documentation of care, medications, and treatments.
* Assists in maintaining compliance with nursing philosophies and objectives, standards of practice, and policies and procedures for all levels of nursing staff.
* Operates within nursing supplies, equipment, and staffing budgets.
* Maintains current knowledge of applicable Managed Care, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations, reimbursement systems, and processes.
* Monitors and helps nursing staff in the following areas:
* Performs nursing assessments regarding the health status of residents.
* Contributes to the resident's assessment (MDS/CAA) and the development of a plan of care.
* Develops a plan of care based on assessment and implements necessary nursing care.
* Evaluates the resident's responses to nursing interventions.
* Establishes appropriate nursing intervention which might be required to stabilize a resident's condition and/or prevent complications.
* Consults with physician or licensed independent practitioner.
* Clarifies orders or treatment as needed.
* Reports and documents the resident's symptoms, responses, and status.
* Educates and counsels residents based on their health needs.
* Collaborates with the resident, resident's responsible party (as needed), physician, and members of the IDT Team in the interest of the resident's healthcare.
* Consults with, utilizes, and initiates referrals to appropriate community agencies and healthcare resources to provide continuity of care.
* Functions within the constraints of established policy and procedure consistent with accepted nursing standards.
* May consult with DON, Administrator, nursing consultants, or other medical professionals to make decisions regarding nursing services, assigned supervisory duties and related tasks.
* Communicates in a professional and courteous manner using effective verbal and non-verbal communication skills with residents, their families, and co-workers.
* Maintains confidentiality of department, resident, employee information, communication, and documentation as well as compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations.
* Clocks in and out for all working/training hours. Working off the clock will not be permitted at any time or for any reason.
* Maintain compliance with Legacy's Compliance program and plan.
* Adhere to Legacy's Code of Conduct and Dress Code.
* These duties are not all-inclusive but provide minimum performance expectations which will be reviewed in the evaluation process. Supervisor may edit, alter, add to, or exclude duties and responsibilities based on the needs of the facility.

**QUALIFICATIONS/ EXPERIENCE/ REQUIREMENTS:**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* Freedom from illegal use of drugs.
* Freedom from use and effects of drugs and alcohol in the workplace.
* Anyone found guilty by a court of law of abusing, neglecting or mistreating individuals in a health care related setting are ineligible for employment in the position.

*Education and/or Experience*

* Registered nurse/Licensed Practical Nurse with management or supervisor experience in long-term care or geriatric nursing.
* *Experience in Long-Term care setting preferred but not required.*

*Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:*

* Current state license to practice as a nurse.
* Current CPR certification and additional certification in nursing specialty desired.

Title: Assistant Claims Manager
Description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

As Assistant Claims Manager, you will lead the delivery of high-quality claims advisory and advocacy services across sensitive and complex medical and life claims. You will support clients and members through critical moments, guide a team of Claims Advisors, and work closely with insurers, third-party administrators and internal stakeholders to achieve fair, timely and effective outcomes.

The role combines hands-on case leadership, complaint resolution, client and insurer engagement, regulatory awareness and people management. You will also contribute to service improvement, technology enablement and the continued development of our claims value proposition.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Lead complex claims and case management**

* Review and provide direction on sensitive, denied, disputed and complex claims, including pre-authorisation escalations, VIP claims and matters escalated by clients or internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate medical evacuation and repatriation cases from initial escalation through resolution, maintaining clear communication with all parties.
* Lead case management for members with sensitive or high-cost conditions, including cancer, rare disorders and terminal illness; review utilisation, cost-containment needs and second medical opinion requirements.
* Provide practical resolution support to team members on denial disputes and complex coverage questions, advocating for outcomes that reflect client expectations and policy terms.
* Escalate emerging risks, disputes and complex cases promptly to the Head of Claims and senior management in line with agreed protocols.
  

  

**Resolve complaints and strengthen client confidence**

* Ensure complaints are fully investigated and responses clearly explain the cause, outcome and actions taken to prevent recurrence.
* Manage complaints that are not upheld by explaining findings, setting clear expectations and guiding members through the appropriate complaint route, including regulatory escalation where required.
* Maintain accurate complaint records in line with internal processes and applicable DHA requirements.
* Participate in client and insurer visits, including sensitive group renewal discussions where your claims expertise is required.
* Prepare quarterly service reports for key clients and provide clear updates on open cases, risks and actions.
  

  

**Build effective insurer and stakeholder relationships**

* Maintain trusted working relationships with insurers and third-party administrators, clearly communicating expectations and advocating for mutual clients.
* Engage with clients, colleagues, providers and insurers to progress complex cases and reach timely, well-supported decisions.
* Participate in periodic case review meetings and ensure actions are documented and closed within agreed timelines.
  

  

**Lead and develop the team**

* Implement team standards, claims procedures and best-practice controls across advisory and transactional claims activity.
* Allocate new accounts and workload, monitor capacity and oversee the smooth delivery of team operations across medical and life claims.
* Review claims files and deliverables to maintain quality, accuracy and service standards; monitor denied cases and cases approaching or exceeding turnaround time.
* Hold regular team and cross-functional meetings, summarise actions and follow through to closure.
* Mentor, coach and train direct reports on procedures, policies, claims practice and effective client interactions.
  

  

**Strengthen compliance, records and service improvement**

* Apply sound knowledge of DHA and DOH mandates, treatment guidelines, exclusions and regulatory updates, and translate relevant developments into practical team guidance.
* Protect confidential information by following data protection, encryption and clear-desk requirements; report and help prevent data incidents.
* Ensure claims, submissions, follow-ups, successes and appreciations are recorded accurately and in real time to support dashboards and management reporting.
* Support technology initiatives, proof-of-concept testing, change adoption, process improvement and appropriate use of AI to create capacity and enhance client service.
  

  

**Support embedded member services**

* Act as a trusted point of contact for members and client representatives under designated client programmes, including on-site support where agreed.
* Explain claims procedures, benefits, co-payments, provider access and approved support channels in clear, accessible language.
* Coordinate pre-authorisation, treatment requests, guarantee-of-payment requests, reimbursement queries, declined or suspended claims and reconsiderations through authorised channels.
* Track requests, missing information, ownership, ageing, escalation history and closure status, ensuring clear handovers and service updates.
  

  

**What you will bring**

* At least seven years of relevant experience in claims, healthcare benefits, insurance or a closely related environment.
* A bachelor’s degree in medicine or a related medical field.
* Experience leading and motivating diverse teams, including colleagues working remotely or across geographies.
* Strong knowledge of insurer claims processes, claims adjudication criteria, market developments and regulatory requirements.
* Proven claims advocacy, complaint resolution, crisis management, negotiation and client-management capability.
* Strong analytical, time-management, computer and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to interpret data and dashboards and turn insight into action.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the judgement and empathy to support members and clients through sensitive situations.
* A practical, improvement-oriented approach to technology, process change and service quality.
  

  

**Working arrangements**

This is a hybrid role with a typical expectation of three days per week in the office. Client-site attendance, working hours and backup arrangements will be agreed separately where the role requires embedded member support. The role carries a low or normal level of physical and mental risk.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. Description:
WHAT ARE WE ABOUT?
  
At Salit Steel, we believe that people are our most valuable asset and that everyone on our team plays a unique role in contributing to our overall success. We are an integrated network of companies and partners that delivers steel solutions across North America. Now in our fifth generation, we have been family-owned and operated since 1905, and we consider our customers, industry partners, and employees to be part of the Salit Steel family. Headquartered in Niagara Falls, Ontario, we have operations across Ontario, Quebec, Western Canada, and the US, providing steel service centre solutions and reinforcing products, including stock and fabricated rebar, as well as specialty products such as assembled rebar, stainless steel rebar, and mechanical tube.
  
  
WHY JOIN US?
  
A values-driven, team-oriented environment – we are like a family
  
Competitive salary and benefits with RRSP matching
  
Opportunities for growth and development
  
A fun place to work!
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Assistant Health & Safety Manager leads the overall health and safety strategy and programs across all steel fabrication facilities and active construction sites (including high-rise residential, institutional, and infrastructure projects). You will drive continuous improvement across our operations in Ontario and Quebec to maintain an effective, safe, healthy, and productive work environment for all employees, contractors, customers, and visitors.
  
  
In this role, you will minimize operational risk, workplace injuries, and occupational health hazards while embedding a culture where safety is a shared responsibility across every level of the organization.
  
  
**Succession Plan Opportunity:** This position is strategically structured as a succession role. The successful candidate will work directly alongside current leadership with a clear, defined pathway to transition into the Health & Safety Manager role.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Strategic Leadership & Culture Creation
  
  

* Drive a company-wide safety culture where safety is an active, shared onus for every employee, empowering teams to identify hazards and stop unsafe work.
* Formulate, implement, and evaluate annual safety goals, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and Safe Work Practices through regular audits.
* Coach and empower plant managers, shop supervisors, and construction site superintendents to lead safety talks, site inspections, and transparent hazard reporting.

Regulatory Compliance & Operations Oversight
  
  

* Ensure total compliance with the Ontario Occupational Health and Safety Act (Industrial and Construction Regulations), Quebec CNESST / LSTT standards, WHMIS 2015, and CSA standards.
* Act as the primary technical safety liaison for regulatory bodies, including the Ontario Ministry of Labour (MLITSD) and Quebec CNESST.
* Lead efforts to achieve, maintain, and audit safety certifications (such as COR) and manage third-party compliance accounts (ISNetworld, Avetta, ComplyWorks).
* Oversee site-specific safety plans (SSSPs), job hazard analyses (JHAs), and safety documentation for major construction bids and kick-off meetings.

Risk Management, Incident Control & Claims Support
  
  

* Oversee hazard assessments and hierarchy-of-controls for high-risk operations (overhead cranes, rebar rigging, working at heights, lockout/tagout).
* Direct root-cause incident investigations for critical injuries and high-potential near-misses, implementing business-wide corrective actions.
* Partner with the Disability & Claims Manager on injury management, providing investigation details and technical safety context for WSIB/CNESST claims and Early & Safe Return to Work programs.

Training, Governance & Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and direct the Health & Safety Coordinator, setting priorities and evaluating performance.
* Oversee safety training modules (Fall Protection, Overhead Crane & Hoist, Heavy Rigging, First Aid, Supervisor Competency) and audit the master training matrix.
* Provide operational governance for Joint Health and Safety Committees (JHSCs) and Site Safety Representatives across all locations.
* Regularly travel to fabrication plants and active job sites to perform safety audits and maintain consistent standards.

Qualifications & Experience
  

* 10+ years of progressive H&S leadership experience within construction, steel fabrication, heavy manufacturing, or industrial environments.
* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* Certifications: NCSO (National Construction Safety Officer) or CRSP (Canadian Registered Safety Professional) preferred; COR Auditor certification is a strong asset.
* Proven track record managing multi-site safety across both fixed manufacturing plants and active civil/structural/high-rise construction sites.
* Strong expertise in Behaviour-Based Safety (BBS) programs, job hazard analyses, and crane/rigging safety standards.
* Working knowledge of WSIB and CNESST processes to effectively assist internal claims specialists.
* Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to influence, coach, and build trust across all levels of the workforce.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel up to 50% across facilities and active job sites.

Project management at Nando's has been strategically embedded into key disciplines: construction administration, technology enablement, and enterprise delivery. These three PMs work together in close coordination to drive our business priorities ahead and land them brilliantly.

As the principal construction delivery (new build and refurbs) and facilities PM, you will work closely with a cross-functional development, design, and construction team to execute new development, capex, and maintenance projects with precision and excellence. You are responsible for overseeing the maintenance, performance, improvement, and execution of facilities and construction-related initiatives across Nando's USA's restaurant and support location portfolio.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

The role supports facilities operations, preventative maintenance programs, vendor and contractor management, capital planning, construction oversight, and project delivery to ensure all locations remain up to brand standards, compliant, operationally effective, and guest-ready. This position serves as a key partner to Operations, balancing restaurant uptime, asset value, project execution, brand standards, risk management, and cost control.

Title: Senior Construction Project Manager
Description:
**About Plexcon Construction**

Plexcon Construction Inc. (plexcon.ca) is a fast-growing residential builder specializing in multiplex conversions, new multiplex builds, laneway and garden suites, additions and major renovations across Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Our clients bring their own architect and design; we build it, from pre-construction to handover. We run about 15 active projects.

As our portfolio and management team continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead our Project Managers and make sure every project is properly planned, bought out, scheduled, documented and delivered within budget.

This is not an office-administration position, and it is not a site superintendent position.

We are looking for an experienced construction professional who understands how projects are built, can identify problems before they escalate, and has the authority and judgment to hold Project Managers accountable.

**Position Overview**

You lead our construction division and report directly to Ownership. Our Project Managers each run three to four projects hands-on, on site and in Procore, and they all report to you. You do not run projects of your own. You work primarily from the office and stay actively involved in the field.

You will be the central point between Ownership, Project Managers, Estimating, Accounting, subcontractors, consultants and clients, and you will make sure:

* Every trade is properly scoped, priced and under contract before it starts.
* Every project finishes within its budget.
* Project schedules are accurate and updated.
* Project Managers complete their commitments.
* Delays, cost risks and client concerns are identified early.
* Project records and compliance documents are complete.
* Company procedures are consistently followed.
* Ownership receives clear and accurate project reporting.

The right candidate will not simply report problems. They will challenge assumptions, develop solutions, assign responsibility and make sure corrective actions are completed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Trades, Scopes and Contracts**

* Receive the budget for each project by line item and trade category.
* Define the scope of work for every trade on every project.
* Source, pre-qualify and price subcontractors and suppliers; level bids and negotiate price and terms.
* Sign all subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Hand each trade to the project's PM with a clear scope, price and dates, so the PM can run the site without gaps.
* Make sure no subcontractor starts without a signed agreement, WSIB clearance certificate, certificate of insurance and Form 1000; maintain a central compliance tracker and monitor expiry dates.
* Track subcontractor performance on quality, reliability, scheduling, pricing, safety and deficiency response; maintain approved and restricted subcontractor lists.
* Monitor original contract values, approved changes and remaining balances; resolve scope gaps and contract disputes.
* Build a reliable subcontractor and supplier network.

**Budget and Cost Control**

* Be accountable for every project finishing within budget.
* Buy out each project at or under the line-item budget.
* Review job-cost, committed-cost and cost-to-complete reports with PMs; identify overruns and margin risks early and require corrective plans.
* Review and approve every client change order before it is sent to the client, and every subcontractor extra before the work proceeds; prevent unauthorized verbal commitments.
* Make sure costs are assigned to the correct projects and categories, and that approved cost and scope changes are communicated to Accounting.
* Confirm invoices match the approved contract and completed work before payment; recommend full approval, partial approval, holdback or rejection. Final payment processing remains with the Financial Controller and Ownership.

**Project Manager Leadership and Accountability**

* Directly supervise all Project Managers; assign projects and balance workload.
* Establish clear weekly priorities and performance expectations.
* Lead the weekly Project Manager operations meeting and regular project reviews with each PM.
* Hold PMs accountable for schedules, budgets, procurement, documentation, client communication and site performance.
* Train and coach PMs on planning, communication, subcontractor management and problem-solving; be their first call for questions on scope, trades, drawings, cost or clients.
* Require recovery plans for troubled projects and step in before issues become major delays, disputes or financial losses.
* Check that commitments and action items were actually completed; identify recurring performance problems, missed deadlines and weak follow-up.
* Escalate serious project or performance concerns to Ownership.
* Assist with interviewing, onboarding, training and evaluating PMs.

**Portfolio and Project Oversight**

* Maintain an accurate overview of every active project: stage, schedule, financial risks, client issues and outstanding decisions.
* Make sure every project has a clear execution plan from startup through closeout.
* Coordinate priorities and management resources across all projects.

**Scheduling and Progress Control**

* Make sure every project has a detailed baseline schedule, updated at least weekly.
* Compare planned progress against actual site progress; review critical-path activities, trade dependencies and long-lead items.
* Confirm materials, subcontractors, inspections and client decisions are aligned with the schedule.
* Identify preventable delays and require recovery schedules when projects fall behind; make sure completion dates are realistic.
* Make sure PMs maintain procurement schedules and that sites are ready to receive and install materials.
* Maintain a company-level project schedule dashboard.

**Policies, Systems and Standard Operating Procedures**

* Develop, implement and maintain Standard Operating Procedures for the entire construction division.
* Implement standardized checklists for project startup, scheduling, procurement, change orders, payment requests, compliance, documentation and closeout.
* Train team members on company procedures, audit whether they are being followed, and take corrective action when they are not.
* Be the company's Procore expert and enforce it: make sure everyone follows protocol in Procore for daily logs, photos, RFIs, submittals, change orders and current drawings.
* Set standard folder structures and naming, and conduct regular project-file audits.
* Keep every project file organized, complete and current, and prevent critical information from remaining only in verbal conversations, texts or personal emails.

**Site Standards, Quality and Safety**

* Conduct routine site audits of every PM's projects for safety, quality, cleanliness and progress; issue written actions and follow up until closed.
* Establish and enforce quality-control procedures; require PMs to inspect and document work before it is covered.
* Make sure construction follows approved drawings, specifications and authorized changes, and that consultant reviews and inspections are coordinated.
* Track permits, inspection results, deficiencies, occupancy requirements and permit closeout; prevent work from proceeding where required approvals are missing.
* Oversee safety administration: site safety documentation, toolbox talks, incident reporting and corrective actions. This role does not replace any legally required constructor, competent supervisor or health and safety representative.

**Project Startup and Closeout**

* Run formal project startup meetings so each PM receives and understands the contract, drawings, permits, budget, schedule, trade scopes and procurement plan.
* Make sure information is properly transferred from Estimating to Construction and Accounting.
* Make sure PMs complete formal closeout: final inspections, occupancy, deficiencies, warranties, manuals, final invoices, holdbacks and client sign-offs.
* Conduct lessons-learned reviews and make sure project records are archived.

**Client and Issue Management**

* Make sure PMs communicate with clients consistently and professionally, and do not make unauthorized promises on cost or schedule.
* Monitor unresolved client concerns, selections and decisions; make sure important decisions and meeting minutes are documented.
* Step into difficult client, consultant or subcontractor situations before they escalate.

**Reporting to Ownership**

* Prepare a clear weekly portfolio report: projects behind schedule, projects at risk of exceeding budget, client and subcontractor issues, missing compliance documents, quality and safety concerns, and decisions required from Ownership.
* Implement a consistent weekly project-reporting format; review and challenge PM reports before issues reach Ownership.
* Flag staffing and resource problems and operational matters affecting cash flow.
* Lead a monthly margin review by project with the Financial Controller.
* Make sure management decisions are implemented.

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience**

* Minimum eight years of progressive residential construction experience with a builder, general contractor or major renovation contractor.
* Experience as a Senior Project Manager, Construction Manager, Operations Manager, Senior Site Superintendent or comparable construction leader.
* Demonstrated experience supervising Project Managers or Site Supervisors, and overseeing multiple active projects at once.
* Hands-on experience defining trade scopes, buying out projects and signing subcontracts.
* Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction through closeout and warranty.

**Required Construction Knowledge**

* Residential construction sequencing and trade coordination, from excavation, underpinning and foundations through framing, MEP, building envelope and interior finishes.
* Ability to read architectural, structural, mechanical and electrical drawings and identify missing scope.
* Project budgets, committed costs, cost-to-complete forecasting, change orders, progress invoicing and holdbacks.
* Ontario Building Code, permits and inspections; Form 1000, WSIB clearances and certificates of insurance.

**Leadership Skills**

* Leadership presence and the ability to earn the respect of experienced construction professionals.
* Comfortable challenging unrealistic schedules, incomplete information and weak explanations.
* Able to hold people accountable professionally and consistently.
* Calm and effective with urgent matters, client concerns and subcontractor disputes.
* Strong judgment, organization and follow-up; takes ownership of problems through to resolution.
* Communicates clearly with Ownership, clients, consultants, subcontractors and employees.

**Technology**

* Procore certification is required within your first 60 days. You will become our expert user, because you will enforce Procore across the team.
* Strong with technology in general and quick to learn new software.
* Construction scheduling software (Microsoft Project or comparable); strong Microsoft Excel.
* Experience creating project dashboards and management reports, and reviewing job-costing reports.

**Education and Credentials**

* Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Construction Engineering Technology, Civil Engineering, Architectural Technology or Building Science; or a Red Seal or Certificate of Qualification in a construction trade (such as carpentry) combined with progressive supervisory experience. Equivalent senior-level residential construction experience will also be considered.
* Gold Seal Certification (Project Manager or Superintendent), PMP, P.Eng. or C.E.T. is preferred.
* Ontario Building Code training or BCIN qualification (House or Small Buildings) is an asset.
* Working knowledge of the Ontario Construction Act (holdbacks, liens and prompt payment) and of Tarion and HCRA requirements.
* Current site safety training: Supervisor Health and Safety Awareness, Working at Heights, WHMIS and Standard First Aid, or willingness to complete them before starting.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid Ontario G driver's licence. A company vehicle is available at the office for site visits.
* Ability to travel regularly between our Richmond Hill office and project sites across the GTA.
* Willingness to occasionally address urgent project matters outside regular business hours.
* Legally entitled to work in Canada.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You can:

* Write a trade scope that leaves no gaps and no room for extras.
* Recognize when a PM's schedule is unrealistic.
* Identify when materials should already have been ordered.
* Determine whether a delay was unavoidable or caused by poor planning.
* Challenge unsupported subcontractor invoices and extras.
* Recognize missing trade scope and coordination problems.
* Help develop practical recovery plans.
* Step into difficult client or subcontractor situations.
* Identify when projects are quietly moving off schedule, over budget or outside company procedures.

We are a very fast-paced company and we are growing quickly. You are driven, punctual and reliable. You multitask well, stay calm and productive under pressure, and are comfortable when priorities change. You are strong with technology. You want to join a winning team and help take the company to the next level.

You are organized, direct, fair and consistent. High-rise only, civil, industrial or coordinator-level backgrounds are not a fit for this role.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first six to twelve months, you will:

* Have every trade on every project properly scoped and under contract, with compliance documents on file.
* Have every active project on an accurate, current schedule and tracking to its budget.
* Establish consistent accountability across all Project Managers.
* Provide Ownership with reliable weekly project-health reporting.
* Put standardized startup, reporting, change-order and closeout procedures in place.
* Reduce missing documentation, unsupported payments and unauthorized extras.
* Improve communication between PMs, Accounting and Ownership, and improve PM performance and follow-through.
* Build scalable systems that support Plexcon's continued growth.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary of $120,000 a year, plus performance bonuses tied to projects finishing on budget and on schedule. Expected total pay: $120,000 to $150,000 a year.
* Company vehicle available at the office for site visits.
* The senior construction role in a growing builder, working directly with Ownership.
* Real authority over trades, budgets and how projects are run.
* The chance to build the systems and develop the team of Project Managers.
* Room to grow with the company as its portfolio and management team expand.

**To Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and a short note covering: how many Project Managers or projects you have overseen at once, the type of builder you worked for, and one process you put in place that improved how projects were delivered.

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted.

**Hiring notices**

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use artificial intelligence tools to help screen applications; a person makes every hiring decision.

We do not require Canadian work experience. Equivalent experience from any country is welcome.

Plexcon Construction Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodation is available on request at every stage of the hiring process, in line with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the AODA.

Applicants who are interviewed will be told the outcome within 45 days of their last interview.

* Have you personally negotiated and signed subcontracts with trades? Briefly describe your role.

* Lead end-to-end logistics operations, including receiving, warehousing, inventory management, order fulfillment and shipping.
* Ensure inventory accuracy and optimize stock levels for medical devices, spare parts and consumables.
* Manage domestic and international shipping operations, including imports, customs clearance and international freight.
* Develop and manage relationships with carriers, customs brokers and third-party logistics providers.
* Optimize logistics costs while improving delivery performance and operational efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with hazardous materials shipping regulations, including lithium battery transportation.
* Oversee warehouse safety, ensuring compliance with applicable OSHA requirements.
