Title: GRC Consultant
Description:
GRC Consultant – Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:** Fourth Command  
**Client:** Reputed Government Organization in Qatar  
**Job Location:** Qatar  
**Number of Vacancies:** 4  
**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Employment Benefits:** Accommodation, Health Insurance and Employment Visa will be provided.

1. Job Overview

Fourth Command is seeking qualified and technically competent Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultants for a cybersecurity consulting engagement with a reputed government organization in Qatar.

The position requires strong technical and functional expertise in information security governance, cybersecurity risk management, regulatory compliance, security architecture, information security auditing, and cybersecurity training and awareness.

The selected candidates will be responsible for assessing the organization's cybersecurity posture, evaluating the effectiveness of security controls, identifying security and compliance deficiencies, developing governance frameworks, and recommending appropriate security improvements.

Candidates must possess a strong understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and cybersecurity technologies, with the ability to independently conduct assessments, manage stakeholder engagements, deliver cybersecurity training, and prepare professional consulting deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English are mandatory.

2. Key Responsibilities2.1. Information Security Governance

* Develop, review, and maintain information security policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks.
* Support the implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Information Security Management System (ISMS).
* Develop cybersecurity strategies, implementation roadmaps, governance processes, and security improvement plans.
* Establish information security roles, responsibilities, accountability mechanisms, and reporting processes.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of information security policies and governance requirements.

2.2. Cybersecurity Risk Management

* Independently conduct enterprise-level, asset-level, application-level, process-level, and project-specific cybersecurity risk assessments.
* Identify cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, control deficiencies, and associated business and operational impacts.
* Develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, cybersecurity risk registers, risk treatment plans, and risk acceptance documentation.
* Evaluate security control effectiveness and determine inherent and residual risk exposure.
* Recommend appropriate technical, administrative, and operational controls to mitigate identified risks.
* Monitor risk treatment activities, validate remediation effectiveness, and escalate critical or unresolved risks.

2.3. Regulatory Compliance and Security Audits

* Conduct compliance assessments, gap assessments, security maturity assessments, and internal information security audits against applicable national and international cybersecurity frameworks.
* Assess organizational compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, Qatar National Information Assurance (NIA), NIST CSF, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop compliance matrices, control mappings, Statements of Applicability (SoA), audit reports, and corrective action plans.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, technical walkthroughs, and evidence-based security control assessments.
* Support regulatory inspections, external audits, and cybersecurity certification initiatives.
* Monitor regulatory developments, track compliance deficiencies, and validate the implementation of corrective actions.

2.4. Security Architecture and Technical Security Assessments

* Review and assess enterprise security architecture, network architecture, infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, and application security architecture.
* Interpret and evaluate network topology diagrams, solution architecture diagrams, data flows, system integrations, and security control placement.
* Identify architectural weaknesses, insecure configurations, inadequate security controls, and potential cybersecurity exposures.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for new technology implementations, infrastructure changes, applications, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Assess the implementation and effectiveness of technical security controls across the following domains:
* Network Security and Network Segmentation.
* Endpoint and Server Security.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Cloud and Application Security.
* Data Security and Data Loss Prevention (DLP).
* Vulnerability and Patch Management.
* SIEM, SOAR, EDR and XDR.
* Security Monitoring and Incident Response.
* Encryption and Cryptographic Controls.
* System Hardening and Security Configuration.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery.
* Review vulnerability assessment reports, penetration testing reports, security configurations, and technical assessment findings to determine associated business risks.
* Evaluate cybersecurity technologies against organizational security requirements and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Apply Zero Trust, defense-in-depth, least privilege, and security-by-design principles during security architecture assessments.

2.5. Third-Party Risk Management and Data Privacy

* Conduct cybersecurity risk assessments of vendors, suppliers, service providers, and technology partners.
* Review third-party security practices, contractual cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory compliance obligations.
* Develop and maintain third-party risk registers, assessment reports, and remediation plans.
* Assess organizational data protection and privacy practices against applicable regulatory requirements.
* Develop and review data classification, information handling, data retention, and data protection requirements.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of data security controls and recommend appropriate corrective measures.

2.6. Business Continuity and Incident Management

* Review and assess Business Continuity Plans (BCP), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRP), and cybersecurity incident response plans.
* Support Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and evaluate Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Assess organizational preparedness for cybersecurity incidents and operational disruptions.
* Develop and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises, incident response simulations, and business continuity exercises.
* Review incident investigation findings, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans.

2.7. Cybersecurity Training and Awareness

* Develop, implement, and maintain organizational cybersecurity training and awareness programs.
* Independently prepare professional training materials, presentations, educational content, and cybersecurity awareness campaigns.
* Conduct cybersecurity training sessions for employees, management, technical personnel, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop role-based training programs aligned with organizational functions and associated cybersecurity risks.
* Conduct specialized workshops covering cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, data protection, and secure working practices.
* Support phishing simulation exercises and other cybersecurity awareness initiatives.
* Establish training schedules, performance indicators, and mechanisms to evaluate training effectiveness.

2.8. Security Performance Monitoring and Reporting

* Develop and maintain cybersecurity Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and security performance measurement frameworks.
* Prepare professional risk assessment reports, compliance reports, audit reports, and technical security assessment reports.
* Develop executive dashboards, management presentations, cybersecurity roadmaps, and periodic security performance reports.
* Monitor outstanding cybersecurity risks, compliance deficiencies, remediation activities, and security improvement initiatives.
* Present technical findings, business risks, and security recommendations to technical teams and senior management.

2.9. Stakeholder Management and Consulting

* Independently conduct client meetings, stakeholder interviews, technical discussions, and cybersecurity workshops.
* Coordinate with business functions, IT teams, cybersecurity teams, auditors, and senior management.
* Provide professional cybersecurity advisory services and technically feasible recommendations.
* Effectively communicate complex technical findings and cybersecurity risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned consulting activities, project commitments, and deliverables in accordance with established timelines and quality standards.

3. Required Qualifications and Skills3.1. Education and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* A minimum of three years of directly relevant professional experience in GRC, information security consulting, cybersecurity risk management, or information security auditing.
* Demonstrable experience in independently conducting risk assessments, compliance assessments, information security audits, and technical security control reviews.
* Practical experience in developing security policies, procedures, risk registers, compliance matrices, and professional assessment reports.
* Experience in reviewing security architecture and evaluating technical cybersecurity controls.
* Experience in developing and delivering cybersecurity training, awareness sessions, and stakeholder workshops.
* Previous experience in client-facing consulting engagements, government organizations, or the GCC region will be an added advantage.

3.2. Knowledge of Standards and Regulatory Frameworks

Candidates must possess strong knowledge and practical understanding of relevant cybersecurity standards and regulatory frameworks, including:

* ISO/IEC 27001:2022 – Information Security Management Systems.
* ISO/IEC 27002 – Information Security Controls.
* ISO/IEC 27005 – Information Security Risk Management.

---------------

  

Reporting to the Vice President & Head of Retail Products and Portfolio Yield Management, Manulife Bank, the AVP, Retail Products is responsible for leading the Bank’s retail product strategy, portfolio performance and transformation agenda across day-to-day banking products and experience, including deposits, credit cards, ATM and debit payments, and unsecured credit strategy. The AVP, Retail Products bridges strategy and execution. The incumbent sets the direction for the retail product portfolio, makes product, investment and portfolio trade-off decisions, and ensures that product propositions, customer experiences and operating capabilities deliver value for customers and the Bank. The AVP is accountable for overall portfolio growth and financial outcomes, including acquisition, activation, engagement and volume delivery. In fulfilling this role, the incumbent will partner across the Bank, including Pricing and Yield Management, Data and Analytics, Marketing, Sales, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Operations and Delivery, to deliver high-quality products, experiences and business outcomes.

  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

Product Strategy and Portfolio Leadership (20%)

  

* Develop, monitor and refine the medium- and long-term strategy for the retail product portfolio, aligned to the Bank’s customer, growth and earnings objectives
* Own the strategic product roadmap and prioritize investments across deposits, credit cards, payments, unsecured credit, relationship banking and day-to-day banking experiences
* Define compelling product propositions, features and lifecycle strategies that strengthen the Bank’s competitive position and deepen customer relationships

* Use customer, market, channel and competitive insights to identify opportunities and inform product and portfolio decisions
  

  

Product Portfolio and P&L Management (20%)

  

* Own the full P&L for the deposit and credit card portfolios, including balances, revenue, margin, expenses, losses and profitability
* Establish product-level performance objectives and operating routines to identify opportunities, address performance gaps and improve portfolio economics
* Make portfolio and P&L trade-offs across growth, customer value, risk, pricing, incentives and investment priorities
* Partner with Pricing and Yield Management to establish pricing and promotional guardrails, optimize margin and yield, and balance customer and financial outcomes
* Oversee product lifecycle decisions, including the launch, enhancement, simplification or retirement of products, features and services
* Provide oversight of credit card product operations, vendor performance, ATM and debit payments, and related customer and operational outcomes
  

  

Transformation and Delivery (30%)

  

* Lead the transformation of the Bank’s day-to-day banking products and customer experiences, with a focus on creating simpler, more connected and relationship-led banking experiences
* Drive the introduction of relationship banking capabilities and new product experiences that support customer growth, engagement and deeper primary banking relationships
* Set transformation priorities and ensure delivery plans remain aligned to the product strategy, target customer experience and expected business benefits
* Partner with Technology, Delivery, Operations and other stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into clear requirements, prioritized roadmaps and high-quality solutions
* Oversee execution from concept through launch, including planning, readiness, testing, implementation, adoption and benefit realization

* Own and oversee product-related corrective action plans, remediation activities and sustainable control improvements
* Ensure effective vendor and partner oversight, including clear performance expectations, governance, issue management and escalation
* Oversee customer communications, forms, disclosures and product collateral to ensure accuracy, consistency and regulatory compliance
* Maintain effective product approval and lifecycle governance, ensuring risks, controls, customer impacts and operational readiness are considered in all material decisions
* Promote strong operational resilience and ensure material product, customer and operational risks are identified, understood and addressed

Description:
**Company Overview**

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Quality Associate carries out the day-to-day quality audits that keep the site's processes accurate, consistent and compliant. Working under the Quality Lead, the Associate audits processes and teams against defined standards, records results accurately, and spots the trends behind errors and defects.

The Associate supports root cause analysis, follows up on corrective actions, and keeps the data behind quality dashboards and reports accurate. This is a fully on-site position with significant time on the production/operations floor, observing processes and giving teams direct feedback.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Audits**

Conduct scheduled and ad hoc quality audits on processes, teams and workstreams, as assigned by the Quality Lead.

Score audits accurately against approved audit forms, scorecards and quality standards.

Document audit findings clearly and completely, with supporting evidence, within set deadlines.

Submit completed audits to the Quality Lead for review and validation before results are reported.

Take part in calibration sessions with the Quality Lead, fellow QA Associates and the client, where applicable, to keep scoring consistent.

Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Action Support

Identify recurring errors, defects and process deviations from audit results.

Support the Quality Lead in root cause analysis using structured methods (e.g., 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams).

Follow up with process owners and team leads on assigned corrective actions and track them to completion.

Carry out effectiveness checks after corrective actions, as assigned, to confirm issues do not recur.

Support 5S implementation and sustainment on the floor.

**Escalations & Complaints**

Gather information and evidence on escalated quality issues, customer complaints and client-flagged incidents, as directed by the Quality Lead.

Log escalations and their outcomes accurately so trends can be tracked.

**Data & Reporting**

Enter and maintain audit data accurately in quality tracking tools and systems.

Extract and prepare data for dashboards tracking audit pass rates, defect/error rates and KPI/SLA adherence.

Flag unusual results, sudden drops in performance, or teams at risk of missing an SLA to the Quality Lead promptly.

Help prepare quality reports for the Quality Lead, QA Manager and the client.

**Process Compliance & Documentation**

Observe processes on the floor and check that teams follow standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Suggest updates to SOPs, audit forms and scorecards based on audit findings.

Use only the current approved versions of quality documentation, and keep audit records organized.

Feedback & Training Support

Give clear, constructive audit feedback to frontline team members and team leads.

Support refresher training and coaching on quality standards where audits show skill gaps.

Contribute ideas to continuous improvement initiatives and Kaizen-style events. "

**Qualifications**

**Required**

1–2 years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, auditing, or a related operations role.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy in scoring, documentation and data entry.

Working knowledge of spreadsheets (e.g., Excel or Google Sheets) for data entry, filtering and basic analysis.

Ability to apply defined standards objectively and consistently.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including giving constructive feedback.

Strong organization and time management, with the ability to meet audit deadlines.

Ability to work fully on-site and move across the floor/facility as needed.

Ability to pass 10 panel drug test

**Preferred**

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Exposure to root cause analysis or corrective/preventive action (CAPA) processes.

Familiarity with 5S, lean or other continuous improvement methods.

Experience with dashboard or reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

Awareness of quality frameworks such as Six Sigma (e.g., Yellow Belt) or ISO 9001.

Experience in a client-facing or SLA-driven environment.

**Core Competencies**

Attention to detail and accuracy

Objectivity and consistency in scoring

Analytical thinking

Clear, constructive communication

Process discipline and SOP compliance

Time management and reliability

Teamwork and openness to coaching

Work Environment

This is a fully on-site role based at the company facility. The Quality Associate spends most of the day on the floor conducting audits, observing processes and giving feedback to teams, with the rest at a workstation recording results and preparing data. Standard business hours apply, with occasional flexibility needed to support audit schedules or reporting deadlines.

Title: Assistant Superintendent of Sewer System Maintenance and Operation (SSMO)
Description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

Plans, organizes, manages and controls the activities of the Sewer System Maintenance and Operation (SSMO) Department. Ensures wastewater collection and storage continues to provide optimum health and safety for customers and communities. Establishes maintenance-related best practices, policies and procedures to ensure appropriate positioning, consistency of processes and delivery of quality service. Serves as lead in directing and managing effective and efficient predictive, preventive and corrective maintenance programs. Ensures proactive responses, cost savings and the effective and efficient operation of wastewater collection system infrastructure, including pump stations, tunnel control structures, regulators, interceptors, rain gauges, odor control facilities, floatable control facilities and level and flow monitors. Serves as Operator of Record for the Collection System. Responds to emergencies and off-hour alarms 24-hours per day including weekends and holidays. Performs other duties of a similar nature as may be required.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Develops and implements departmental goals and monitors the alignment with Maintenance Services and strategic goals. Directs and implements processes to work within Sewer District policies and procedures to ensure adherence to the law, to meet permit regulations and standards and maintain safety. Reviews accident investigation reports and makes recommendations and takes appropriate action, as necessary.

- Provides guidance for short- and long-term planning that meets necessary budget requirements, creates schedules and allocates staff appropriately. Participates in the development and implementation of functional level strategy.

* Reviews the operating and minor capital budgets and expenditures for the department in order to ensure adherence to the budget. Assists in the preparation and presentation of the department’s annual budget.

* Identifies and implements process improvement initiatives to address operational challenges, enhance efficiency, reduce costs and promote workplace safety. Evaluates existing processes and adapts business practices to support continuous improvement and evolving organizational needs.

* Reviews, evaluates and analyzes trends in data to make decisions that satisfy operation, maintenance, safety and engineering guidelines.

* Oversees the development and implementation of preventive maintenance programs, including planning and scheduling maintenance activities. Ensures standby equipment is maintained in proper operating condition, monitors equipment performance to identify malfunctions, approves necessary repairs and replacements and maintains adequate inventory of parts and supplies.

* Provides 24-hour emergency response to off-hour alarms and incidents, including weekends and holidays. Serves in various roles within the Sewer District’s incident command structure, including oversight of department-specific emergencies and acting as Incident Commander when needed. Provides input on emergency response plans and the SSMO Field Procedure Manual and participates in the development and execution of emergency response drills.

* Ensures timely mark outs of Sewer District facilities in response to the Ohio Utility Protection Service (OUPS) tickets. Establishes procedures for and directs the implementation of an effective and consistent safety program.

* Coordinates with various departments in the development and administration of contracts and specifications. Reviews engineering designs, plans and specifications and provides recommendations. Manages projects, prepares bid specifications and assists with contract awards and administration, including emergency contracts, as needed. Ensures maintenance contracts are properly executed and managed in accordance with Sewer District policies and guidelines.

* Manages department personnel, including conducting interviews, making hiring and promotion recommendations and overseeing employee performance and development. Coaches and mentors staff, supports training and professional development and ensures employees maintain required qualifications and certifications. Resolves personnel issues, maintains discipline and morale, participates in grievance and disciplinary hearings and initiates or recommends appropriate disciplinary actions.

* Serves as a point of contact for customer complaints, evaluating and coordinating appropriate responses with service directors or designated contacts. Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with regulatory agencies and local government entities.

* Analyzes operational and maintenance data to develop reports for various audiences, including staff and upper management and delivers presentations at department, Board and community meetings. Plans, leads and participates in meetings and cross-functional teams to effectively coordinate resources and achieve organizational objectives.

* Sets priorities and allocates resources (people, materials and money) to coordinate maintenance activities and identify the need for capital equipment, improvements and expenditures.

* Assesses, evaluates and improves maintenance management system outputs to ensure quality to comply with Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), state and local regulations and minimize the Sewer District’s risk for permit violations and to meet key performance indicators. Ensures standardization of maintenance practices and continuous improvement initiatives are implemented.

* Serves as Operator of Record for the Collection System.

* Serves as Superintendent of Maintenance Services in their absence. Completes routine administration duties, including writing correspondence, describing technical situations in lay terms; creates proposals; and maintains detailed records.

* Performs other duties of a similar nature may be required.

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**

EDUCATION

* Candidate must possess a bachelor’s degree, preferably in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Applied Science, Industrial Management, Business or a closely related field.

* Equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as outlined in the Education Equivalencies Policy.

EXPERIENCE

* Candidate must possess five (5) years of experience in operating and maintaining a wastewater collection system. Experience with the Sewer District’s Collection System is preferred.

* Experience must include three (3) years of supervising, managing and/or leading people, projects or processes.

* Experience in working with Collective Bargaining Union workforce and contractors preferred.

**OTHER REQUIREMENTS**

LICENSURE AND CERTIFICATIONS

* Candidate must possess a valid driver’s license with a driving record in accordance with the Sewer District’s acceptable guidelines.

* Candidate must possess a valid Ohio EPA Class II Wastewater Collection System Operator Certificate or valid Ohio EPA Class II Wastewater Treatment Operator Certificate at the time of being placed in the position.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

* Candidate must demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to foster positive working relationships and effectively communicate with internal stakeholders and external agencies and a strong commitment to customer service. Requires proven experience in project and budget management, including establishing, monitoring and improving performance metrics.

* Candidate must be able to manage competing priorities, work effectively under pressure and meet established project deadlines. Candidate must possess strong presentation and facilitation skills to communicate new ideas, lead discussions and meetings and gain support and commitment across all levels of the organization.

* Candidate must demonstrate strong leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate, develop and delegate to staff to build an effective team capable of managing complex projects and increasing responsibilities.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

During the course of performing the essential functions of this position, the employee must be able to analyze, communicate, comprehend, coordinate, make decisions, possess general intelligence, interact, interpret, negotiate, possess numerical intelligence, organize, problem solve, have resilience and perform tasks. Physical work will need to be performed, such as bending, climbing, crawling, crouching, driving, kneeling/squatting, reaching, sitting, standing, talking, typing and walking. Repetitive movements will need to be performed such as simple grasping with one or both hands. Ability to push, pull and lift from floor to waist, waist to shoulder or floor to shoulder up to 40 lbs. on an occasional basis may be necessary. Position will require visual demands of accommodation, color vision, depth perception, far acuity and near acuity. Ability to withstand extremely loud noise exposure for fifteen minutes or longer on an infrequent basis is required. Exposure to environmental conditions such as respiratory hazards, outdoor work, vibrations, work around large machinery, work at heights and work inside confined spaces is encountered in this position. Employee must possess the ability to wear required respiratory protection devices, including not having facial hair that interferes with the facepiece-to-face seal.

Title: New Business Representative
Description:
Requisition ID # 175695
  
  
**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Stockton
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
The Strategy and Growth functional area is dedicated to long-term strategic and infrastructure planning. With electricity demand expected to double over the next 15 years, we’re building an energy system of the future for the world’s fourth-largest economy. It includes Energy Policy and Procurement, Strategy and Innovation, Integrated Long-Term Planning, and the Commercial Growth Organization.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
This job is represented by Engineers and Scientists of California (ESC) and subject to collective bargaining.
  
  
This is a Beginning Level Classification. Additional consideration may be given to candidates who reside within 50 miles of the headquarters.
  
  
This position is charged with customer contact, project coordination, billing, and contract preparation in connection with less complex installation of new business gas and/or electric facilities. NBRs will not prepare job estimates. This does not preclude job owners from preparing invoices or contracts based on simplified charge methodology.
  
  
A New Business Representative may be assigned no more than 50% of their workload in SNBR-level jobs at the same time and must work under the guidance of a Senior New Business Representative or IPE.
  
  
Employees hired into this classification from outside the bargaining unit will not have their bids or transfers considered under the provisions of title 21 for a period of 24 months following their employment date (“employment date” means the date placed into the regular classification, not date of hire with PG&E if different)
  
  
Employees in this classification may still bid to higher classifications in the same line of progression while still within the 24-month period.
  
  
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the PG&E Service Territory.
  
  
PG&E is providing the hourly rate that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This position is subject to collectively bargained hourly wage rates and increases. The starting wage rate for this position is $51.01 per hour. This wage rate is specific to the locality of the job. The wage rate is based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
SAFETY
  
Maximize public and employee safety by ensuring that job designs are performed to Company and State standards and meet all compliance requirements.
  
  
PROJECT MANAGEMENT
  
Prepares pre-design job packages with all required information including field sketch layouts for the scoping of construction and accurate field data including pictures measurements.
  
Manages scope and schedule and cost for all assigned projects, from initiation to meter set.
  
Coordinates all other departments or individuals who are involved with the project and works to define the project’s background, objective, design scope, schedule, roles, and responsibilities.
  
Coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to complete the project in a timely manner. Includes understanding of project schedules and working closely with the work and resource group to prioritize work using available tools or technology.
  
Proactively manages a new business portfolio of work to ensure compliance to standard work or ensures variances are in accordance with company guidelines. Effectively monitors project schedule and prioritizes work in coordination with dependency partners and construction execution teams.
  
Schedules and conducts project meetings, provides all pertinent data and addresses potential project risks including schedule setbacks and coordinates actions before setbacks occur.
  
Ensures that project is performed as planned or manages project delays in accordance with company guidelines.
  
Looks for ways to minimize costs on projects for both the applicant and PG&E.
  
Ensures that the correct type of financial order, work category, etc., has been applied and actively monitors costs.
  
  
FIELDING
  
Fielding including job site visits and customer meetings are required. Fielding will include but not limited to site visits for pre-design job package creation. facilitating pre-construction meetings, verifying site readiness and any emergent issues that might require a site visit.
  
NBRs will gather information on field conditions for pre-design packages for single locations. A single location is defined as one or more of the following:
  
**a. Electric:** Nearest point of electric distribution to panel, service work only if within 200 feet for Under Ground (UG) or 150 Over Head (OH).
  
**b. Gas:** Nearest point of gas distribution main to single meter location, service work only, if within 200 feet.
  
If a and/or b occurs more than once within a single premise, NBRs will field these as well (Example: House and Pump). At all other locations, the Job Owners Checklist is required, and the Field Notes Template is optional for each NBR, who will consult with their assigned mentor or supervisor as to whether collecting that information will be efficient.
  
  
COMMUNICATION
  
Communicates project status (e.g., scope, schedule, and cost) to all stakeholders throughout the project, as applicable.
  
Facilitates resolution of project-related disputes. Continuous formal communication (both written and verbal) with all stakeholders is given a high priority throughout all stages of the project.
  
Prepares contracts, as applicable, to ensure compliance with standards and tariffs.
  
Provides applicants, estimating, engineering, clerical and construction partners with complete and accurate information on rate and rule applicability, potential costs and timelines.
  
  
MANAGING CUSTOMER EXPECTATIONS
  
Proactively communicates to project stakeholders, both internal and external.
  
Negotiates reasonable estimating and construction dates that address customer’s anticipated schedules and meets compliance requirements, including communications and timelines. May provide customer with an initial non-binding cost.
  
  
TARIFFS
  
Ensures that all charges mandated under the applicable tariffs are identified in the contract and secured before beginning construction. This position is responsible for ensuring correct tariff interpretation and application, and for working with Law department on exceptional case projects when required.
  
Partner with other PG&E departments and/or rates and tariffs for application of best rates when appropriate.
  
  
COMPLIANCE MANAGEMENT
  
Ensures all applicable project documentation is maintained in the system of record.
  
Ensures all project dependencies are met prior to allowing a construction start.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor’s degree from a recognized college or its equivalent experience. Such experience must include three (3) or more years of experience in construction project management or PG&E technical service planning or 12 months of experience as a Hiring Hall (HH) New Business Representative, HH Senior New Business Representative and/or HH Engineering Estimator
  
Must have strong project management, customer contact and communications skills. Basic computer skills including Microsoft Word, Excel, email.
  
Valid California Driver's License and California minimum insurance coverage if using personal car
  
Driving is an essential function of this job, therefore the employee must have and maintain a valid driver’s license.
  
  
**Desired:**  
Additional consideration may be given to candidates that reside within 50 miles of the headquarters
  
Must have strong project management, customer contact and communications skills. Basic computer skills including Microsoft Word, Excel, email.
  
Familiar with tariffs, rates, contracts/tools, Work Management (WM) SAP and work processes and tools.
  
Works effectively as a member of a team
  
Ability to work with both internal and external customers/clients
  
Facilitation and conflict resolution skills
  
Ability to manage for results and in the process work as a team to build agreement
  
Strong focus on safety
  
Committed to providing superior and proactive customer service
  
Strong verbal and written communication skills
  
Ability to demonstrate initiative and decisiveness
  
Ability to demonstrate sound judgment and forward thinking
  
Problem solving skills
  
Computer skills (SAP, Microsoft Excel, Word, etc.)
  
Conflict resolution skills
  
Measurement skills and ability to use some physical tools (drive stake in the ground, use Range Finder or Height Stick and Shovel, etc.) in the field
  
  
**Pre-Employment Testing:**  
**Internal PG&E Employees :** Qualified on the Physical Test Battery (PTB) and Work Orientation Inventory (WOI) prior to applying
  
**External and Hiring Hall Candidates :** Qualified on the Physical Test Battery (PTB) and Work Orientation Inventory (WOI) prior to interviewing

Our recent affiliations and ongoing growth make it possible for us to serve more patients, closer to where they live and work. * Reviews recognized outside expert opinions and partners with medical staff experts and utilization review leadership and team to develop parameters for appropriate hospital status and billing.
* Educates all members of the patient care team, through day-to-day interactions and intermittent group presentations on utilization review guidelines on an on-going basis.
* Performs Medical Record retrospective and concurrent reviews and other data collection activities that assist in identifying potential quality issues and opportunities for improvement in documentation of patient care and services.

* Shall be and remain a member in good standing of the NM Medical Staff
* Shall be qualified by training, experience, interest, demonstrated current ability, and board certification in the clinical area covered by the department.
* Must be knowledgeable about working with an adult population ranging from adolescent to geriatric, including patients with communications barriers, sensory impairment, and physical limitations, including but not limited to developmental, mobility, vision or hearing impairments
* Must be able to identify appropriate measures and accommodations to meet the needs of the department
* Must be able to communicate and interact effectively with payers to resolve issues.

Title: Tier 2 Customer Experience Agent
Description:
**Who We Are**

At BlueCosmo, we keep people connected where cell coverage ends. From remote adventures to critical business operations, we provide satellite phones, messengers, and data solutions that help people stay connected when it matters most.

As a Roadpost brand, we partner with leading satellite networks, including Iridium and Inmarsat, and offer trusted products like ZOLEO. But we’re more than just a hardware retailer; our business is built on lasting subscriber relationships, with recurring airtime services at the heart of what we do.

We’re focused on growing that connection – bringing new customers on board, keeping existing subscribers engaged, and delivering reliable communication beyond the reach of cellular networks.

**Why This Role Matters**

We sell satellite telephony — Iridium phones, Inmarsat handsets, GO devices, SIM cards, and airtime plans. AI handles the straightforward volume. What reaches you is the stuff that actually needs a human: a phone that won't connect in the field, a SIM that isn't provisioning, a customer who needs to be in the right plan before they fly out tomorrow. The problems that reach you are telephony-based — power, signal acquisition, dialing, SIM provisioning, airtime balances, number management, and device configuration.

Reporting to the MSS Team Lead, you own those issues start to finish, and you take the initiative to pick up what's next. The customers who contact us depend on their satellite device for continuity of communication — sometimes in genuinely remote or high-risk situations. That urgency is part of the job.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Ownership and continuity of communication.** This is the headline quality we hire for. Take the ticket, work it, close it. Customers in the field cannot afford gaps in coverage — that reality should drive how you prioritize. If you can't resolve something, you find out how. You take the lead on the next step rather than waiting for a manager to assign it, point you to a call, or explain what needs to be done. This role is a great fit for people who enjoy that kind of independence.
* **Product and service knowledge.** Know every product we sell and what it does: Iridium and Inmarsat satellite phones, Iridium GO, Beam and ASE docking stations, SIM cards, airtime plans, and the full range of antenna and cabling configurations. Occasionally you'll help customers who are still figuring out what they need — comparing plans, asking about coverage, or deciding between devices. You're not selling; you're helping them land on the right answer. That means knowing our products well enough to give a confident, accurate recommendation without a script.
* **Self-direction and problem solving.** Box in the issue before you start solving it. Triage properly — eliminate what it isn't before you decide what it is. Use the web, manufacturer documentation, forums, and AI tools to find answers. Curiosity and a drive to learn are essential in this role. When a fix doesn't work, you try a new angle rather than repeating the same step. When you genuinely can't resolve something, you escalate with a full brief and still own the customer interaction to closure.
* **Working with AI.** You'll use AI every day — to research problems, find solutions, and learn faster. You'll also judge whether an AI response to a customer is actually right, and flag to our Optimization team when it isn't. When you spot a repeat issue across tickets that could be automated or handled without a human, you bring it forward. We want people who ask how this could be solved at the system level, because improving the AI's handling of common issues is part of how this team succeeds. That contribution is valued here.
* **Knowledge base contribution.** When you solve something new, or find that an existing article is wrong or missing, you document it. KB articles and updated SOPs are part of your output. The team's collective knowledge is only as good as what gets written down.
* **On-call rotation.** You'll rotate for after-hours emergencies and periodic weekend ticket handling alongside the rest of the team — a handful of incidents per month at most. These are real situations: a customer whose satellite phone stopped working the night before a remote expedition, or a vessel that's lost communications.

**What You Bring**

* **Experience.** 3–5 years in wireless, satellite, or telecom customer support — Tier 2 or equivalent experience
* **Technical Troubleshooting.** Comfortable with telephony troubleshooting: signal, SIM provisioning, number management, dialing issues, firmware, antenna and cabling configurations
* **Self-Starter.** Demonstrably self-directed — you find answers without being told where to look
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication — clear, accurate, and direct with customers
* **Ticketing Tools.** Proficient with Zendesk or equivalent ticketing platform; CRM experience an asset
* **AI Fluency.** Experience using AI tools as a daily working resource, not just occasionally
* **Languages.** French language fluency a strong asset — bilingual candidates strongly preferred

**What We Offer**

* **Salary Range.** $62,000–$65,000 CAD base salary.
* **After-hours.** Separate compensation and plan for the after-hours and weekend on-call rotation.
* **Flexible Work.** A hybrid model; balancing collaboration and lifestyle flexibility, with scheduled shifts Monday to Friday between 9am–7pm ET within an availability window of 8am–8pm
* **Comprehensive Benefits.** Health, dental, and flexible spending accounts tailored to your needs.
* **Time to Recharge.** Vacation and sick days to help you rest, recharge, and stay well.
* **Growth Investment.** A continuous learning environment backed by a professional development budget.
* **Inclusive by Nature.** A values-driven workplace where diverse perspectives are celebrated.

**Apply Now**

Our recruitment process may use artificial intelligence tools, alongside human review, to assist with the screening or assessment of candidates.

We are currently hiring for this role and welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible workplace. If you meet around 70% of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply — we’d love to hear from you.  
  
We’re happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process; if you require support, please let us know when you apply, and we’ll work with you to meet your needs

Title: Controller
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Syncopate CPA Professional Corporation helps entrepreneurs strengthen their businesses through accounting, tax and financial leadership services.

We serve owner-managed businesses, charities and not-for-profit organizations with services ranging from bookkeeping, payroll and tax compliance to controllership, financial planning and analysis, and fractional CFO support.

As a modern, technology-enabled CPA firm, we leverage cloud-based systems, automation and collaborative tools to deliver efficient, high-quality service and insights to our clients.

When you join Syncopate, you'll work closely with a portfolio of clients and a team committed to learning, growth and meaningful impact.

**OUR APPROACH TO TEAMWORK**

At Syncopate, we believe strong relationships are the foundation of great work. We strive to create an environment where team members trust one another, communicate openly, and support each other's growth.

We encourage our team to think like owners. Whether serving clients, improving processes, developing technical expertise, or supporting colleagues, everyone is empowered to contribute ideas and take initiative. We believe meaningful career growth comes from a combination of learning, experience, mentorship, and increasing responsibility.

We also believe that diverse perspectives lead to better decisions and stronger outcomes. That's why we strive to attract, develop and support individuals from a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and identities.

We welcome applications from members of historically marginalized communities and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of record of offences or any protected ground under the Ontario Human Rights Code.

**THE ROLE**

The Controller leads the delivery of financial leadership services to a portfolio of clients and serves as Syncopate's primary point of accountability for the overall client experience and successful delivery of our services. By combining strong technical expertise with business insight, the Controller helps our clients understand the story behind their numbers in order to make better business decisions.

As a Controller, you will work closely with members of the Syncopate team, providing coaching, mentorship and technical leadership while supporting the development of less experienced team members. You will help create an environment where clients receive exceptional service and team members can do their best work.

This role falls within Syncopate's Management Job Stream and may be classified as Controller I (Grade 8/M2) or Controller II (Grade 9/M2) depending on demonstrated leadership, experience, expertise and impact.

Progression is based on increasing expertise in financial leadership, complexity of client situations, scope of decision-making support provided to clients, leadership of engagement teams, and contribution to client and firm outcomes.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Portfolio Leadership & Engagement Management (~80% of your time)**

* Serve as Client Manager for a portfolio of accounting, tax and advisory engagements, acting as the primary point of accountability for the client relationship and coordinating service delivery across the engagement team. Take ownership of successful delivery, quality, client experience and growth, particularly for larger, more complex or higher-risk engagements.
* Take ownership of the commercial health of your client portfolio, including budgets, work in progress (WIP), scope and profitability, and recommend changes to pricing, services or engagement terms as client needs evolve.
* Provide financial leadership and decision support, helping clients understand their financial information, identify trends, risks and opportunities, and make better business decisions.
* Provide senior-level technical oversight and review of accounting, financial reporting, tax and other client deliverables, applying sound professional judgment to more complex matters.

**Team Leadership & Development (~10% of your time)**

* Provide leadership, coaching, mentorship and technical support to members of the Client Service team
* Pursue ongoing professional development to strengthen your technical and leadership skills
* Foster a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement

**Firm Growth & Practice Development (~10%)**

* Actively contribute to the growth of the firm by developing referral relationships, identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, and participating in networking and business development activities
* Contribute to the development of service offerings, templates, processes and best practices
* Identify opportunities to improve client service delivery, operational efficiency and the effective use of technology.

**WHO YOU MIGHT BE**

Strong candidates...

* Have a CPA designation and 8+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including meaningful experience in financial, client, engagement and/or team leadership
* May be experienced public accounting Seniors or Managers, or have developed strong financial reporting, tax, internal controls and process improvement capabilities in an industry role
* Are respected team leaders that are sought out for coaching and mentorship, are skilled at delegating, and are also willing to be hands on in a small team environment
* Are skilled in all the relevant tools of the profession – large and small accounting systems, Excel, online collaboration software – and, more importantly, enjoy diving into new systems to learn how to get the best out of them

**COMPETENCIES**

We are looking for someone who:

* **Has integrity**: Embodies courage and responsibility. Acts honourably, even when no one is watching. Making mistakes is perfectly okay, denying them or covering them up is not.
* **Is accountable**: Cares deeply about getting results. Stays on top of all responsibilities, consistently meets deadlines, and communicates proactively when challenges arise.
* **Is courageous**: Asks for help when they need it and communicates when they have concerns about a client or coworker, even if it’s someone more senior than themselves.
* **Is coachable and willing to coach others**: Considers themselves a continual learner in all aspects of life – both professionally and personally. Is willing to learn from anyone regardless of their position or status. Is patient and willing to share their knowledge with others on the team, and with our clients.
* **Has strong interpersonal skills**: Actively listens. Seeks first to understand. Communicates their message clearly and assertively. Takes a collaborative approach to their work. Respects diversity of opinion and experience.
* **Extends trust**: Articulates their needs and gives others a second, and if necessary a third, chance to do better.

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

In this role you are expected to work a **minimum of 20 hours per week**. During the busier times of the year, longer hours may be required based on client needs and the seasonal nature of our work.

Syncopate operates in a hybrid work environment, combining the flexibility of remote work with regular time together in person. This role requires you to **work from our Markham office on at least two of your scheduled working days each week**, with the remainder of your schedule worked remotely if you choose.

You’ll be provided with a laptop and monitor, plus an allowance to purchase a keyboard, mouse, and headphones. For remote work, you will be responsible for providing a suitable workspace and a reliable high-speed internet connection.

The full-time equivalent starting salary range for this position is $103,000 to $145,000, with actual starting salary determined by the job level at which the successful candidate is hired.

Candidates hired as Controller I (Grade 8) would typically start between approximately $103,000 and $126,000 on a full-time equivalent basis, while candidates hired as Controller II (Grade 9) would typically start between approximately $119,000 and $145,000 on a full-time equivalent basis.

The level and starting salary will be determined based on the successful candidate's experience, expertise, leadership capability, and ability to independently lead complex client engagements and provide financial leadership and decision support.

*As this is a part-time position,* ***the actual annual salary will be prorated*** *based on the agreed working schedule.*

All employees are entitled to 4 weeks of annual vacation time off per our Vacation Policy. After three months of employment, you will be entitled to enroll in our benefits plan which includes a Health and Wellness Spending Account valued at $1,250 annually for part-time staff (pro-rated in your first year) along with virtual healthcare and an employee assistance plan.

**HOW TO APPLY**

**STEP TWO**: Selected candidates will be invited to complete online pre-screen application

**STEP THREE**: Interviews will be conducted in person at our office (1st) and online (2nd)

**STEP FOUR**: Verbal offer contingent on reference checks

**STEP FIVE**: Formal job offer

A World leader in air cargo. We possess a geographical advantage that enables us to reach over 140 destinations across 6 continents. Our SkyCargo group works in partnership to facilitate global trade and connect customers with their destinations. state-of-the-a

rt, multi-airport hub in Dubai and adapt to our customers ever-changing needs.

  

As Cargo Charter Support Officer, you provide dedicated and specialised support to the three areas in EK Cargo Freighters **and Charter Operations** .

Undertake planning, coordination and implementation of all matters relating to Freighter operation in SkyCargo. This includes all aspects of charter operations, ensuring both operational and commercial integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

Ensure that all activities take place in an effective and efficient manner so as to ensure all **freighter and charter services** are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, schedule adjustments, additional operations and new route introductions.

Undertake the management of other aspects of Freighter Department including **charter-related system requirements** .

In this role, you will:

* SCHEDULE PLANNING:
    
  Prepare seasonal freighter schedules in a timely manner ensuring all commercial and operational requirements are met. Ensure all permissions and permits are obtained from government and other agencies for the smooth operation of scheduled freighter services **and charter operations** for incorporation and publication in the quarterly airline timetable so that the freighter network information is available to customers. Provide support to the Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager in slot co-ordination activity especially from an operational perspective when additional charter flights are operated or obtaining specific slots during schedule disruptions so as to be able maintain the required performance level on slot utilisation such that slot historic are protected.
    
  Monitor the schedules of all the freighters and charter flights ensuring its effectiveness and efficiency so that all services are adequately covered especially at times of schedule disruptions, adjustments to schedules and additional operations.

* OPERATIONS PLANNING:
* Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with the wet lease aircraft operators (Atlas Air, TNT and others) ensuring that the operator is provided monthly schedules in a timely manner and that the operator is able to fulfil Emirates schedules, **including supporting charter flight requirements where applicable** .

  Coordinate monthly freighter schedules with other Emirates operational departments ensuring that they are provided in a timely manner and that Emirates is capable of fulfilling them. This also requires checking back with the operator to ensure that the operator's planning information reflect Emirates requirements **for both freighter and charter operations** .

  When special charter flights are operated, the job holder is required to travel to outstations, especially off-line stations and/or stations that do not have freighter expertise, to ensure all operational activity in relation to the charter is performed according to company standards and customer's satisfaction.

  **Support the operational planning and coordination of ad-hoc charter flights, ensuring all stakeholder requirements are met before, during and after operation.**
* DEVELOPMENT & ANALYSIS:
* Manage all other carrier (OAL) block space agreements ensuring that agreements are current and where renewal is due initiate renewal negotiations.

  Assist in the negotiate with carriers with block space agreements for the optimal cancellations in accordance with agreed cancellation allowances, so as to ensure Emirates commercial objectives are not compromised.

  Undertake planning, operations within the Freighter department, with regard to medium and long term freighter and charter operations ensuring operational integrity is maintained while meeting all safety, quality and customer service standards.

  **Conduct charter feasibility assessments including operational constraints, airport capabilities, slots, permits, aircraft suitability and customer requirements.**
* GENERIC (TO ALL 3 AREAS):
* Identify requirements that need to be incorporated into the New Generation Cargo System (NGSC) on an ongoing basis for the effective and efficient management of all freighter and charter related activity prioritising the necessary requirements and emphasising the specific requirements.

  Ascertain and collate all cost data related to freighter and charter operations ensuring that accurate data is captured in the NGSC system.

  Determine the accurate computation of all cost data related to freighter/charter operations within the system and identify and correct any anomalies.

  Provide information on the profitability of all ad-hoc freighter operations, charter operations and diversions ensuring that information related to such operations are communicated to all relevant internal departments.

  **Prepare analysis and reporting on charter performance, operational efficiency and profitability to support management decision-making.**

  Independently handle special projects as directed by Manager Freighter Operations & Charters, Manager Freighter Analysis & Development or Cargo Scheduling & Planning Manager.

  The job holder will also be required to undertake special projects related to special ground handling requirements and operational procedures related to new aircraft especially the Boeing 777F and Boeing 747-8F **as well as support special cargo projects, humanitarian charters and strategic charter initiatives.**

##### **Qualification**

**Qualifications & Experience:** Should have good knowledge of IATA regulations, rules and procedures.

Should have completed approved Cargo Acceptance and Handling courses including Special Cargo Handling and Acceptance, Cargo Product Knowledge, Advanced Load Control and Freighter Load Control.

Excellent communication & IT skills.

Should have sound analytical skills.

Description:

**Job Title:** Medication Technician (Med Tech)

**Location:** Assisted Living

**Department:** Nursing - Assisted Living

**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt

**Reports to:** Director of Assisted Living

**Position Summary:**

Provides and is responsible for assisting in the administering of medications to residents as ordered by the attending physician, under the direction of the attending physician. The administration of medications shall be in accordance with established nursing standards, the policies, procedures and practices of this facility, and the requirements of this state.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Administers medications to residents following the policies and procedures governing the Assisted Living Center.
* Performs administrative requirements, such as completing necessary forms, charges, reports, etc., and submits as may be required.
* Accurately and safely prepares, administers, and documents the oral and/or topical medications that are commonly used in an Assisted Living Center and that may be ordered for a resident’s use by the attending physician or the Medical Director.
* Verifies that any medications brought into the Assisted Living are by a newly admitted resident are examined and identified by the attending physician or the facility pharmacy or Pharmacist.
* Follows and adheres to the labeling policies and practices of the Assisted Living Center.
* Ensures that all medications administered are properly labeled.
* Performs medication charting as directed by the Nurse Supervisor/Charge Nurse. Follows Assisted Living procedures regarding charting of medications.
* Follows Assisted Living policies and procedures regarding the destruction of medications; assists in carrying out these processes under the direction of the Assisted Living Pharmacist or the Director of Assisted Living, including documentation requirements.
* Assists in documenting and removing medications that are discontinued by the attending physician.
* Follows Assisted Living procedures governing drug receipt errors, including notifying the delivery source and the Director of Assisted Living.
* Ensures that medication is returned and reordered, except emergency drugs.
* Ensures that documentation of the drug receipt error includes a written error report, signed by an observer/witness and the Medication Technician.
* Adheres to Assisted Living procedures in holding medications for residents who are transferred from the facility or when the attending physician discontinues a medication.
* Accurately measures, records, and reports the vital signs of residents.
* Observes and verifies that medication is ingested or applied as directed. Documents any instance where prescribed medication is not administered, including reason(s) for refusal.
* Promptly notify the Nurse Supervisor/Charge Nurse or the Director of Assisted Living of any errors or reactions to medications by residents.
* Follows the medication card practices of the Assisted Living Center.
* Ensures that each medication is administered with a written, signed, dated order from an attending licensed physician.
* Adheres to the procedure for recording the order in the resident’s clinical record, including the type, route, dosage, frequency, and strength of each medication.
* Verifies the identity of the resident before administering the medication treatment.
* Communicates and interacts effectively and tactfully with Residents, visitors, families, peers and supervisors.
* Reports all hazardous conditions, damaged equipment and supply issues to the supervisor.
* Communicates and interacts effectively and tactfully with Residents, visitors, families, peers and supervisors.
* Attend staff meetings and in-services as requested. Attends in-service and education programs and attends continuing education required for maintenance of professional certification or licensure.
* Answers and respond to call lights promptly and courteously when working in resident care areas
* Reports all resident concerns to the appropriate department head.
* Perform job duties while operating in compliance with federal and state laws/regulations, and facility policies and procedures.
* Regular and reliable attendance.
* Perform other tasks as required.
* Ability to work with residents who may have cognitive, behavioral, or physical impairments.
* Ability to work in potentially stressful or emergency situations.

Supervisory Responsibility:

This position does not have direct supervisory responsibilities. However, all employees are expected to lead by example, demonstrate professionalism, support their supervisors and leadership team, and contribute positively to the success of the team and organization.

Requirements:

**Required/Desired Qualifications:**

Education, Training, and Experience:

* High School diploma or equivalent.
* Successful completion of AFC/HFA Medication Administration Course upon hire.

- One (1) to two (2) years of HFA Medication Technician experience preferred. Healthcare, senior living or long- term care experience preferred.

* Exemplary computer skills that include knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite of products.

Specific skills, knowledge, and abilities:

* Must be able to read, write, and perform basic mathematics.
* The ability to verbally communicate effectively with residents, staff, and visitors.
* Shows dependability by being punctual and maintaining good attendance.
* The ability to maintain a safe environment for Residents and co-workers.
* The ability to transport Residents and equipment as needed.

Other Special Requirements:

* Ability to work nights and weekends to accommodate the needs of the residents.
* Tolerate potential exposure to blood, body tissues, and fluids with occasional exposure to hazardous materials and infectious diseases.
* Manual dexterity that is required to operate modern office equipment.

### **About the Country/Multi-Country Office**

Governments at the 19th Session of the UN-Habitat Governing Council, adopted by consensus resolution 19/18 calling on UN-Habitat to establish a Special Human Settlements Programme for the Palestinian People (SHSPPP) and a Technical Cooperation Trust Fund (TCTF). The long-term development objective of the SHSPPP is to improve the human settlements conditions of the Palestinian People and in so doing contribute in a modest way to reaching peace, security and stability in the region. At its 23rd session, the Governing Council adopted a resolution requesting UN-Habitat "to further focus its operations on planning, land and housing issues in view of improving the housing and human settlement conditions of Palestinians, addressing the urbanization challenges, supporting the building of a Palestinian State, humanitarian action and peace-building, in the areas where there are acute humanitarian and development needs, identified through technical assessments by UN-Habitat in coordination with all concerned parties".

The United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is the agency for human settlements. It is mandated by the UN General Assembly to promote socially and environmentally sustainable towns and cities with the goal of providing adequate shelter for all. The post is located in the Special Human Settlements Programme for the Palestinian People.

### **Job Specific Context**

With the overall guidance and direct supervision of the Head of Operations, the Communications Officer will support the planning, production, coordination and dissemination of accurate, accessible and timely communications products that showcase UN-Habitat Palestine’s programmes, results and partnerships. The incumbent will work closely with programme and operations colleagues, partners and relevant UN communications focal points, applying UN-Habitat branding, visibility, editorial and information-management requirements.

The Communications Officer supports the implementation of UN-Habitat Palestine’s communications and visibility activities to promote the organization’s programmes, achievements and partnerships.
